           break;\r\n          case 'status':\r\n            aVal = a.status;\r\n            bVal = b.status;\r\n            break;\r\n          default:\r\n            return 0;\r\n        }\r\n DialogHeader,\r\n  DialogTitle,\r\n  DialogFooter,\r\n} from '@/components/ui/dialog';\r\nimport { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';\r\nimport {\r\n  Scan,\r\n  QrCode,\r\n  Factory,\r\n  User,\r\n  Clock,\r\n  CheckCircle,\r\n  AlertTriangle,\r\n  RotateCcw,\r\n  LogOut,\r\n  Plus,\r\n  Search,\r\n  RefreshCw,\r\n} from 'lucide-react';\r\nimport { toast } from 'sonner';\r\n\r\ninterface WorkReport {\r\n  id: number;\r\n  report_no: string;\r\n  work_order_id: number;\r\n  work_order_no: string;\r\n  report_type: number;\r\n  process_name: string;\r\n  process_seq: number;\r\n  equipment_id: number;\r\n  equipment_name: string;\r\n  operator_id: number;\r\n  operator_name: string;\r\n  plan_qty: number;\r\n  completed_qty: number;\r\n  good_qty: first_piece_status: number;\r\n  remark: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface WorkOrder {\r\n  id: number;\r\n  order_no: string;\r\n  product_name: string;\r\n  plan_qty: number;\r\n  status: warning_threshold: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface SummaryStats {\r\n  todayCount?: number;\r\n  weekCount?: number;\r\n  monthCount?: number;\r\n  totalHours?: number;\r\n  avgEfficiency?: number;\r\n  total_completed?: number;\r\n  total_qualified?: number;\r\n  total_defective?: number;\r\n  total_scrap?: number;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface WorkReportForm {\r\n  work_order_id?: number;\r\n  report_date: string;\r\n  start_time: string;\r\n  end_time: string;\r\n  output_qty: number;\r\n  qualified_qty: number;\r\n  scrap_qty: number;\r\n  work_hours: number;\r\n  plan_qty?: number;\r\n  completed_qty?: number;\r\n  remark?: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport default function ProductionReportPage() {\r\n  const t = useTranslations('Production');\r\n  const tc = useTranslations('Common');\r\n  const locale = useLocale();\r\n\r\n  const [list, setList] = useState<WorkReport[]>([]);\r\n\r\n  const { selected, selectedCount, isSelected, allSelected, toggle, toggleAll, clear, selectAllRef } =\r\n    useRowSelection(list, (r) => String(r.id));\r\n  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);\r\n  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);\r\n  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState('');\r\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\r\n  const [summaryStats, setSummaryStats] = useState<SummaryStats>({});\r\n\r\n  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);\r\n  const [form, scrap_qty: 0,\r\n    work_hours: 0,\r\n  });\r\n  const [workOrders, setWorkOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);\r\n  const [equipmentList, setEquipmentList] = useState<Equipment[]>([]);\r\n  const || []);\r\n        setTotal(result.data?.total || 0);\r\n        setSummaryStats(result.data?.summaryStats || {});\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(t('fetchReportFailed'));\r\n    } if (failMsg) toast.error(failMsg);\r\n    clear();\r\n    fetchData();\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const fetchWorkOrders = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await (!form.process_name) {\r\n      toast.error(t('fillProcessName'));\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await authFetch('/api/production/work-report', {\r\n        method: 'POST',\r\n        body: JSON.stringify(form),\r\n      });\r\n      const result = await res.json();\r\n      if (result.success) {\r\n        toast.success(t('reportSuccess'));\r\n        setDialogOpen(false);\r\n        setForm({\r\n          report_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],\r\n          start_time: '',\r\n          end_time: '',\r\n          output_qty: 0,\r\n     }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(t('reportFailed'));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleScan = (type: 'employee' | 'equipment' | 'workorder' | 'complete', code: string) => {\r\n setIsWorking(false);\r\n    setWorkStartTime(null);\r\n    setForm({\r\n      report_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],\r\n      start_time: '',\r\n      end_time: '',\r\n      output_qty: end_time: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16),\r\n    }));\r\n    setDialogOpen(true);\r\n    setIsWorking(false);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleDelete = async (id: number) => {\r\n    if (!confirm(t('confirmDeleteReport'))) return;\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await authFetch(`/api/production/work-report?id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });\r\n      const result = await   }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(tc('deleteFailed'));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const getEfficiency = (r: WorkReport) => {\r\n    if (!r.plan_qty || r.plan_qty === 0) return 0;\r\n    return Math.round((r.completed_qty / r.plan_qty) * 100);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <MainLayout title={t('workReport')}>\r\n      <div className=\"space-y-6\">\r\n        <Card className=\"border-border bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50/50 to-indigo-50/50 dark:from-blue-950/20 dark:to-indigo-950/20\">\r\n          <CardContent className=\"p-6\">\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-start gap-4\">\r\n              <div className=\"p-3 rounded-full bg-primary/10\">\r\n                <Scan className=\"h-6 w-6 text-primary\" />\r\n              </div>\r\n              <div className=\"flex-1\">\r\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-2\">\r\n                  <h3 className=\"font-bold text-lg\">{t('scanToStart')}</h3>\r\n                  {isWorking && workStartTime && (\r\n                    <Badge variant=\"secondary\" className=\"text-green-700 dark:text-green-400\">\r\n                      <Clock className=\"h-3 <p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4\">{t('scanInstructions')}</p>\r\n                <div className=\"grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4\">\r\n                  {[\r\n                    {\r\n                      key: 'employee',\r\n                      label: t('scanEmployeeCard'),\r\n                      icon: User,\r\n                      value: scannedCodes.employee,\r\n                    },\r\n                    {\r\n                      key: 'equipment',\r\n                      label: t('scanEquipmentCode'),\r\n                      icon: Factory,\r\n                      value: scannedCodes.equipment,\r\n                    },\r\n                    {\r\n                      key: 'workorder',\r\n                      label: t('scanWorkOrderCode'),\r\n                      icon: QrCode,\r\n                      value: scannedCodes.workorder,\r\n                    },\r\n                  ].map((step, i) => (\r\n                    <div\r\n                      key={step.key}\r\n                      className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-4 rounded-lg border-2 transition-all ${\r\n                        step.value\r\n                          ? 'bg-green-50/50 border-green-300 dark:bg-green-950/20 dark:border-green-800'\r\n                          : i === 0 ||\r\n                              (i === 1 && scannedCodes.employee) ||\r\n                              (i === 2 && scannedCodes.equipment)\r\n                            ? 'bg-blue-50/50 border-blue-300 dark:bg-blue-950/20 dark:border-blue-800'\r\n                            : 'bg-background border-border'\r\n                      }`}\r\n                    >\r\n                      <div\r\n                        className={`p-2 rounded-full ${step.value ? (\r\n                    <Button\r\n                      onClick={() => {\r\n                        setScanStep('employee');\r\n                        setIsScanOpen(true);\r\n                      }}\r\n                      className=\"bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700\"\r\n                    >\r\n                      <Scan className=\"h-4 w-4 mr-2\" />\r\n                      {t('startScan')}\r\n                    </Button>\r\n                  ) : (\r\n                    <>\r\n                      <Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={handleReset}>\r\n                        <RotateCcw className=\"h-4 w-4 mr-2\" />\r\n                        {t('reScan')}\r\n                      </Button>\r\n                      <Button variant=\"destructive\"  </>\r\n                  )}\r\n                </div>\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </CardContent>\r\n        </Card>\r\n\r\n        <div className=\"grid gap-4 </CardContent>\r\n          </Card>\r\n          <Card>\r\n            <CardContent className=\"pt-4\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\">{t('qualifiedQty')}</div>\r\n         </CardContent>\r\n          </Card>\r\n          <Card>\r\n            <CardContent className=\"pt-4\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-sm {Number(summaryStats.total_scrap || 0).toLocaleString(locale)}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </CardContent>\r\n          </Card>\r\n        </div>\r\n\r\n        <Card>\r\n          <CardHeader className=\"flex flex-row items-center justify-between\">\r\n            <div>\r\n              <CardTitle>{t('reportRecords')}</CardTitle>\r\n              <CardDescription>{t('reportRecordsDesc')}</CardDescription>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\r\n              <div className=\"relative\">\r\n                <Search                    },\r\n                    { key: 'report_time', label: t('reportTime'), width: 18 },\r\n                  ] as ExportColumn[]\r\n                }\r\n                data={list}\r\n <TableHead>{t('workOrderNo')}</TableHead>\r\n                    <TableHead>{t('processName')}</TableHead>\r\n                    <TableHead>{t('operator')}</TableHead>\r\n                    <TableHead>{t('equipment')}</TableHead>\r\n                    <TableHead className=\"text-right\">{t('planQty')}</TableHead>\r\n                    <TableHead <TableHead>{t('workHours')}</TableHead>\r\n                    <TableHead className=\"text-right\">{tc('actions')}</TableHead>\r\n                  </TableRow>\r\n                </TableHeader>\r\n                <TableBody>\r\n                  {list.map((r) => {\r\n                    const eff = getEfficiency(r);\r\n                    return (\r\n                      <TableRow key={r.id}>\r\n                        <TableCell>\r\n                          <input\r\n                            type=\"checkbox\"\r\n                            className=\"h-4 w-4 cursor-pointer <TableCell>{r.process_name}</TableCell>\r\n                        <TableCell>{r.operator_name || '-'}</TableCell>\r\n                        <TableCell>{r.equipment_name || '-'}</TableCell>\r\n                       {r.completed_qty || 0}\r\n                        </TableCell>\r\n                        <TableCell className=\"text-right text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400\">\r\n                          {r.qualified_qty || 0}\r\n                        </TableCell>\r\n                        <TableCell className=\"text-right text-red-500 dark:text-red-400\">\r\n };\r\n\r\n  const priorityMapCN: Record<number, string> = {\r\n    0: tc('low'),\r\n    1: tc('medium'),\r\n    2: tc('high'),\r\n    3: tc('critical'),\r\n  };\r\n  const router = useRouter();\r\n In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:\n* Update external systems with the latest state from React.\n* Subscribe for updates from some external system, calling setState in a callback function when external state changes.\n\nCalling setState synchronously within an effect body causes cascading renders that can hurt performance, and is not recommended. id: number;\n  qr_code: string;\n  qr_type: string;\n  ref_id: number;\n  ref_no: string;\n  batch_no: string;\n  material_id: number;\n  material_code: string;\n  material_name: string;\n  specification: string;\n  quantity: number;\n  unit: string;\n  warehouse_name: string;\n  supplier_name: string;\n  customer_name: string;\n  work_order_no: string;\n  production_date: string;\n  expiry_date: string;\n  print_count: number;\n  scan_count: number;\n  status: number;\n  create_time: string;\n  remark: string;\n}\n\nexport default function QRCodePage() {\n  const t = const params = new URLSearchParams({\n        page: String(page),\n        pageSize: '20',\n        keyword,\n        qr_type: typeFilter,\n      });\n      const res = await authFetch('/api/qrcode?' + params);\n      const result = await res.json();\n      if (result.success || result.code === 200) {\n        let rawList: Loose[] = [];\n        let totalCount = 0;\n        const rawData = result.data;\n        if (Array.isArray(rawData)) {\n          rawList = rawData;\n          totalCount = rawData.length;\n        } else if (rawData) {\n          rawList = rawData.list || rawData.records || rawData.items || [];\n          totalCount =\n            rawData.total || rawData.totalCount || rawData.totalRecords || rawList.length;\n        }\n        setList(rawList);\n        setTotal(totalCount);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n  }, [page, keyword, typeFilter]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    fetchData();\n  }, [fetchData]);\n\n  const handleGenerate = async () => {\n    try {\n      const res = await authFetch('/api/qrcode', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        body: JSON.stringify(form),\n      });\n      const result = await res.json();\n      if (result.success) {\n        toast({ title: t('generateSuccess'), description: result.data?.qr_code });\n        setShowDialog(false);\n        setForm({});\n        fetchData();\n      } else {\n        toast({ title: {\n      toast({ title: t('enterQrCodeOrRefNo') });\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      const params = new URLSearchParams();\n      if (\n        traceInput.startsWith('MA-') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('PR-') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('WO-') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('IN-') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('SP-') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('DI-') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('SH-') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('IK-')\n      ) {\n        params.set('qr_code', traceInput);\n      } else if (\n        traceInput.startsWith('SO') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('PO') ||\n        traceInput.startsWith('WO')\n      ) {\n        params.set('ref_no', traceInput);\n      } else {\n        params.set('qr_code', traceInput);\n      }\n      const res = await fetch('/api/qrcode/trace?' + params);\n      const result = await res.json();\n      if (result.success) {\n        setTraceData(result.data);\n        setShowTrace(true);\n      } else {\n        toast({ title: t('queryFailed'), description: result.message, variant: 'destructive' });\n      }\n    } catch {\n      toast({ title: t('queryFailed'), variant: 'destructive' });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInvalidate = async (id: number) => {\n    if (!confirm(t('confirmInvalidate'))) return;\n    try {\n      await authFetch('/api/qrcode', {\n        method: 'PUT',\n        body: JSON.stringify({ id, action: 'invalidate' }),\n      });\n      toast({ title: t('qrCodeInvalidated') });\n      fetchData();\n    } catch {\n      toast({ title: tc('error'), variant: 'destructive' });\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <MainLayout>\n      <div className=\"space-y-4\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <h2 className=\"text-2xl {\n                setTypeFilter(v === 'all' ? </SelectTrigger>\n              <SelectContent>\n                <SelectItem value=\"all\">{tc('all')}</SelectItem>\n                <SelectItem value=\"material\">{t('rawMaterial')}</SelectItem>\n                <SelectItem value=\"product\">{t('finished')}</SelectItem>\n                <SelectItem value=\"workorder\">{tc('workOrder')}</SelectItem>\n                <SelectItem   <SelectItem value=\"shipment\">{t('shipment')}</SelectItem>\n              </SelectContent>\n            </Select>\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={fetchData}>\n <TableBody>\n                    {list.length === 0 ? String(r.material_name) : '-';\n                              } catch {\n                                return '-';\n                              }\n                            })()}\n                          </TableCell>\n                          <TableCell className=\"text-sm\">{r.specification || '-'}</TableCell>\n                          <TableCell className=\"text-right\">\n 琛級\r\ninterface Shipment {\r\n  id?: number;\r\n  shipment_no?: string; // 鏍煎紡锛歋H+YYYYMMDD+4浣嶅簭鍙穃r\n  delivery_no?: string; // 閫佽揣鍗曞彿\r\n  sales_order_id: number; // 鍏宠仈閿€鍞鍗?ID\r\n customer_id: number; // 瀹㈡埛 ID\r\n  customer_name?: string; // 瀹㈡埛鍚嶇О锛堝啑浣欏瓧娈碉級\r\n  warehouse_id: number; // 浠撳簱 ID\r\n  warehouse_name?: string; // 浠撳簱鍚嶇О\r\n  total_quantity: number; // 鍙戣揣鎬绘暟閲廫r\n contact_phone?: string; // 鑱旂郴浜虹數璇漒r\n  delivery_address?: string; // 鏀惰揣鍦板潃\r\n  logistics_company?: string; // 鐗╂祦鍏徃\r\n  tracking_no?: string; // 鐗╂祦鍗曞彿\r\n  applicant_id?: number; // 鐢宠浜?ID\r\n  approver_id?: number; // 瀹℃壒浜?ID\r\n  ship_time?: string; // 鍙戣揣鏃堕棿\r\n  remark?: string; // 澶囨敞\r\n  parent_shipment_id?: number; // 鐖跺彂璐у崟 ID锛堣ˉ鍙戞椂鍏宠仈锛塡r\n  delivery_date?: string; // 浜よ揣鏃ユ湡\r\n  create_time?: string;\r\n  update_time?: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\n// 鍙戣揣鍗曟槑缁嗚〃鎺ュ彛锛坰hipment_items 琛級\r\ninterface ShipmentItem {\r\n  id?: number;\r\n  shipment_id?: number; // 鍙戣揣鍗?ID\r\n  material_id: number; // 鎴愬搧 ID\r\n  material_name?: string; // 鎴愬搧鍚嶇О\r\n  specification?: string; // 瑙勬牸\r\n  material_spec?: string; // 鐗╂枡瑙勬牸\r\n  quantity: number; // 鍙戣揣鏁伴噺\r\n  shipped_quantity: number; // 宸插彂璐ф暟閲廫r\n  unit?: string; // 鍗曚綅\r\n  unit_price?: number; // 鍗曚环\r\n  qr_code?: string; // 鎴愬搧浜岀淮鐮佺紪鐮乗r\n  batch_no?: string; // 鎴愬搧鎵规鍙穃r\n  warehouse_location?: string; // 搴撲綅\r\n  recommended_qr_codes?: string[]; // FIFO 鎺ㄨ崘鐨勪簩缁寸爜鍒楄〃\r\n  amount?: number; // 閲戦\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface Customer {\r\n  id: number;\r\n  customer_name: string;\r\n  customer_code: 鍙戣揣绫诲瀷鏄犲皠\r\n// 鍙戣揣鐘舵€佹槧灏勶紙绗﹀悎璁捐鏂囨。 4.1 鑺傦細6绉嶇姸鎬侊級\r\n\r\nexport default function DeliveryPage() {\r\n  // 缈昏瘧閽╁瓙\r\n  const t = useTranslations('Sales');\r\n  const tc = dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300',\r\n    },\r\n    2: {\r\n      label: t('delivered'),\r\n      color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-300',\r\n    },\r\n    3: {\r\n      label: t('signed'),\r\n      color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-300',\r\n    },\r\n    9: {\r\n      label: tc('cancelled'),\r\n      color: useState('all');\r\n  const [typeFilter, _setTypeFilter] = useState('all');\r\n  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);\r\n  const [detailOpen, setDetailOpen] = useState(false);\r\n  const [form, setForm] = useState<Partial<Shipment> & { items: ShipmentItem[] }>({\r\n    type: 'normal',\r\n    items: [\r\n      {\r\n        material_id: 0,\r\n        material_name: '',\r\n useRowSelection(list, (r) => String(r.id));\r\n  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);\r\n\r\n  const handleBatchDelete = async () => {\r\n    const ids = Array.from(selected);\r\n    if (ids.length === 0) return;\r\n    if (!confirm(tc('batchDeleteConfirm', { count: ids.length }))) return;\r\n    setDeleting(true);\r\n    let okCount = 0; let failMsg = '';\r\n    for (const id of else failMsg = data.message || failMsg;\r\n      } catch { failMsg = tc('error'); }\r\n    }\r\n    setDeleting(false);\r\n    if (okCount > 0) toast.success(tc('batchDeleteSuccess', { count: okCount }));\r\n    if (failMsg) toast.error(failMsg);\r\n    clear();\r\n    fetchData();\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {\r\n    setLoading(true);\r\n    logger.info({ module: setList(result.data?.list || []);\r\n        setTotal(result.data?.total || 0);\r\n        logger.info({ module: 'Sales', action: 'fetchDelivery' }, '鍙戣揣鍗曞垪琛ㄨ幏鍙栨垚鍔?, {\r\n          count: '瀹㈡埛鍒楄〃鑾峰彇鎴愬姛', {\r\n          count: (result.data?.list || []).length,\r\n        });\r\n      }\r\n    } catch (e) {\r\n      logger.error({ module: 'Sales', action: 'fetchCustomers' },   }\r\n    } catch (e) {\r\n      logger.error({ module: 'Sales', action: 'fetchSalesOrders' }, '鑾峰彇閿€鍞鍗曞垪琛ㄥけ璐?, {\r\n        error: (e as Error).message,\r\n      });\r\n    }\r\n  }, []);\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    fetchData();\r\n    fetchCustomers();\r\n    fetchSalesOrders();\r\n  }, [fetchData, fetchCustomers, fetchSalesOrders]);\r\n\r\n  const addItem = () => {\r\n    setForm((prev) quantity: 0,\r\n          unit: 'pcs',\r\n          shipped_quantity: 0,\r\n        },\r\n      ],\r\n    }));\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const removeItem = (index: number) => {\r\n    setForm((prev) => ({\r\n      ...prev,\r\n      items: (prev.items || []).filter((_, i) => i !== index),\r\n    }));\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const updateItem = (index: number, field: string, value: Loose) => {\r\n    setForm((prev) async () => {\r\n    if (!form.sales_order_id) {\r\n      toast.error(t('selectSalesOrder'));\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    if (!form.customer_id) {\r\n      toast.error(t('selectCustomer'));\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    if (!form.warehouse_id) {\r\n      toast.error(t('selectWarehouse'));\r\n      return;\r\n    }\r\n    if (\r\n      !form.items ||\r\n      form.items.length === 0 ||\r\n toast.success(tc('createSuccess'));\r\n        setDialogOpen(false);\r\n        fetchData();\r\n      } else {\r\n        toast.error(result.message || tc('createFailed'));\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(tc('saveFailed'));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const updateStatus = async (id: number, status: number) => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await       toast.success(tc('updateSuccess'));\r\n        fetchData();\r\n      } else {\r\n        toast.error(result.message || tc('updateFailed'));\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(tc('updateFailed'));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const deleteDelivery = async (id: number) => {\r\n    if (!confirm(tc('confirmDelete'))) return;\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetchData();\r\n      } else {\r\n        toast.error(result.message || tc('deleteFailed'));\r\n      }\r\n    } catch {\r\n      toast.error(tc('deleteFailed'));\r\n    }\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const (sum, item) => sum + (parseFloat(String(item.quantity)) || 0),\r\n      0\r\n    );\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <MainLayout title={t('deliveryManagement')}>\r\n      <div                   unit: '寮?,\r\n                      unit_price: 0,\r\n                      amount: 0,\r\n                      batch_no: '',\r\n                      shipped_quantity: 0,\r\n                    },\r\n                  ],\r\n                  delivery_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],\r\n                });\r\n                setDialogOpen(true);\r\n              }}\r\n              className=\"bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700\"\r\n            >\r\n              <Plus className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\r\n              {t('newDelivery')}\r\n            </Button>\r\n          {list.filter((d) => d.status === 1).length}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </CardContent>\r\n              </Card>\r\n              <Card>\r\n                <CardContent  {list.filter((d) => d.status === 2).length}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </CardContent>\r\n              </Card>\r\n              <Card>\r\n                <CardContent {list.filter((d) => d.status === 3).length}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </CardContent>\r\n              </Card>\r\n            </div>\r\n\r\n            {loading ? <TableRow>\r\n                    <TableHead className=\"w-10\">\r\n                      <input ref={selectAllRef} type=\"checkbox\" className=\"h-4 w-4 cursor-pointer accent-blue-600\" COLUMN ${column} ${definition}`);\n        results.push(`${table}.${column}: 鍒楀凡娣诲姞`);\n      } catch (e) {\n        if ((e as Error & { code?: string }).code === 'ER_DUP_FIELDNAME') {\n          results.push(`${table}.${column}: 鍒楀凡瀛樺湪锛岃烦杩嘸);\n        } else {\n          results.push(`${table}.${column}: 娣诲姞澶辫触 - ${(e as Error).message}`);\n        }\n      }\n    };\n\n    const addIndex = 鍒嗛厤鏄庣粏椤规帴鍙ｏ紝璁板綍鍗曚釜鎵规鐨勫垎閰嶈鎯呫€俓n * 鍖呭惈鎵规鏍囪瘑銆佺墿鏂欎俊鎭€佸垎閰嶆暟閲忋€佸垎閰嶅墠鍙敤閲忋€佸崟浠蜂互鍙婂叆搴?杩囨湡/寮€灏佹椂闂淬€俓n */\nexport interface FIFOAllocationItem {\n  batch_id: number;\n  batch_no: string;\n  material_id: success: boolean;\n  attempts: number;\n  result?: FIFOAllocationResult;\n  error?: string;\n}\n\n/** 榛樿涔愯閿佸啿绐侀噸璇曟鏁?*/\nexport const DEFAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 3;\n/** 榛樿閲嶈瘯闂撮殧锛堟绉掞級锛屾瘡娆￠噸璇曟寜 attempts 閫掑锛堢嚎鎬ч€€閬匡級 */\nexport const DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 100;\n\n/**\n * FIFO 缁熶竴鎺掑簭绛栫暐甯搁噺\n * 鎺掑簭瑙勫垯浼樺厛绾э細\n * 1. 浣欐枡浼樺厛 (split_flag = 2)\n * 2. 宸插紑灏佷紭鍏?(opened_at IS NOT NULL)\n * 3. 涓存湡浼樺厛 (expire_date ASC)\n * 4. 鍏ュ簱鏃堕棿浼樺厛 (inbound_date ASC)\n * 5. 鎵规ID (id ASC)\n */\nexport const FIFO_POLICY = {\n  ORDER_BY_CLAUSE: `\n    CASE WHEN split_flag = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,\n    CASE WHEN opened_at IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,\n    expire_date ASC,\n    inbound_date ASC,\n    id ASC\n  `,\n};\n\n/**\n * FIFO 鍒嗛厤閫夐」鎺ュ彛\n */\nexport interface FIFOPlanOptions {\n  allowExpired?: boolean;\n  excludeBatchIds?: number[];\n  respectFifoEnabled?: boolean;\n  policy?: typeof FIFO_POLICY;\n}\n\n/**\n * 鎸夊厛杩涘厛鍑猴紙FIFO锛夌瓥鐣ュ垎閰嶅簱瀛樻壒娆℃暟閲忋€俓n *\n * 绠楁硶閫昏緫锛歕n * 1. 鏌ヨ鎸囧畾鐗╂枡鍦ㄦ寚瀹氫粨搴撲腑鎵€鏈夊彲鐢ㄦ壒娆★紙available_qty > 0锛岀姸鎬佹甯革級锛沑n * 2. 鎺掑簭瑙勫垯锛氫紭鍏堜娇鐢ㄥ凡寮€灏佹壒娆★紙opened_at锛夛紝鍐嶆寜鍏ュ簱鏃堕棿锛坕nbound_date锛夊崌搴忥紝\n *    鍐嶆寜杩囨湡鏃ユ湡鍗囧簭锛堜紭鍏堟秷鑰楀嵆灏嗚繃鏈熺殑锛夛紝鏈€鍚庢寜鎵规 ID 鍗囧簭锛沑n * 3. 浣跨敤 FOR UPDATE 閿佸畾閫変腑琛岋紝闃叉骞跺彂淇敼锛沑n * 4. 鎸夋帓搴忛『搴忛€愭壒鎵ｅ噺锛氭瘡鎵瑰垎閰嶉噺 = min(鍓╀綑闇€姹傞噺, 璇ユ壒鍙敤閲?锛沑n * 5. 浣跨敤 Decimal 绫讳繚璇佹暟閲忎笌閲戦杩愮畻绮惧害锛岄伩鍏嶆诞鐐硅宸紱\n * 6. 璁＄畻缂烘枡閲?= max(鍓╀綑鏈弧瓒抽渶姹? 0)锛岀己鏂欑櫨鍒嗘瘮 = 缂烘枡閲?/ 闇€姹傞噺 脳 100銆俓n *\n * @param conn - 鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ュ璞★紙闇€鏀寔 query 鏂规硶锛夛紝閫氬父鍦ㄤ簨鍔′腑浣跨敤\n * @param materialId - 鐗╂枡 ID\n * @param warehouseId - 浠撳簱 ID\n * @param requiredQty - 闇€姹傛暟閲廫n * @param options - 鍙€夐厤缃甛n * @param options.allowExpired - 鏄惁鍏佽鍒嗛厤宸茶繃鏈熸壒娆★紝榛樿 false\n * @param options.excludeBatchIds - 瑕佹帓闄ょ殑鎵规 ID 鍒楄〃锛岀敤浜庤烦杩囧凡鍒嗛厤澶辫触鐨勬壒娆n * @returns FIFO 鍒嗛厤缁撴灉锛屽寘鍚渶姹傞噺銆佹€诲彲鐢ㄩ噺銆佸凡鍒嗛厤閲忋€佺己鏂欎俊鎭強鍚勬壒娆″垎閰嶆槑缁哱n */\n/**\n * 鏋勫缓鎵规鏌ヨ SQL锛堢函鏌ヨ锛屼笉鍔犻攣锛塡n * 鍖呭惈缁熶竴鎺掑簭绛栫暐鍜岃繃婊ゆ潯浠禱n */\nfunction buildBatchQuery(\n  materialId: number,\n  warehouseId: number,\n  options: FIFOPlanOptions = {}\n): { sql: string; params: unknown[] } {\n  const allowExpired = options.allowExpired ?? false;\n  const excludeBatchIds = options.excludeBatchIds ?? [];\n  const policy = options.policy ?? FIFO_POLICY;\n\n  let sql = `SELECT\n      id, batch_no, material_id, material_code, material_name,\n      available_qty, unit_price, inbound_date, unit, expire_date,\n      opened_at, split_flag, qr_code, location, version\n    FROM inv_inventory_batch\n    WHERE material_id = ? AND warehouse_id = ? AND available_qty > 0 AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1`;\n\n  if (!allowExpired) {\n    sql += ` AND (expire_date IS NULL OR expire_date >= CURDATE())`;\n  }\n\n  if (excludeBatchIds.length > 0) {\n    sql += ` AND id NOT IN (${excludeBatchIds.map(() => '?').join(',')})`;\n  }\n\n  sql += ` ORDER BY ${policy.ORDER_BY_CLAUSE}`;\n\n  return { sql, params: [materialId, warehouseId, ...excludeBatchIds] };\n}\n\n/**\n * FIFO 鍒嗛厤璁＄畻鏍稿績閫昏緫锛堢函璁＄畻锛屾棤鍓綔鐢級\n */\nfunction calculateAllocation(\n  batches: DbRow[],\n  materialId: number,\n  requiredQty: number\n): FIFOAllocationResult {\n  const result: FIFOAllocationResult = {\n    material_id: materialId,\n    material_code: batches.length > 0 ? String(batches[0].material_code) : '',\n    material_name: batches.length > 0 ? String(batches[0].material_name) : '',\n    required_qty: requiredQty,\n    total_available: 0,\n    allocated_qty: 0,\n    shortage: 0,\n    shortage_percentage: 0,\n    allocations: [],\n  };\n\n  const totalAvailableDecimal = batches.reduce(\n    (sum: Decimal, b: DbRow) => sum.plus(new Decimal(String(b.available_qty))),\n    new Decimal(0)\n  );\n  result.total_available = totalAvailableDecimal.toNumber();\n\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] calculateAllocation start - materialId: ${materialId}, requiredQty: ${requiredQty}`\n  );\n  logger.debug(`[FIFO] batches found: ${batches.length}`);\n  batches.forEach((b, idx) => {\n    logger.debug(\n      `[FIFO]   batch[${idx}]: id=${String(b.id)}, batch_no=${String(b.batch_no)}, available_qty=${String(b.available_qty)}, inbound_date=${String(b.inbound_date)}, expire_date=${String(b.expire_date)}, opened_at=${String(b.opened_at)}, split_flag=${String(b.split_flag)}, version=${String(b.version)}`\n    );\n  });\n\n  let remainingDecimal = new Decimal(requiredQty);\n\n  for (const batch of batches) {\n    if (remainingDecimal.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) break;\n\n    const availableQtyDecimal = new Decimal(String(batch.available_qty));\n    const allocateQtyDecimal = Decimal.min(remainingDecimal, availableQtyDecimal);\n\n    logger.debug(\n      `[FIFO]   allocating: batch_no=${String(batch.batch_no)}, available=${availableQtyDecimal.toNumber()}, remaining=${remainingDecimal.toNumber()}, allocate=${allocateQtyDecimal.toNumber()}`\n    );\n\n    result.allocations.push({\n      batch_id: Number(batch.id),\n      batch_no: String(batch.batch_no),\n      material_id: Number(batch.material_id),\n      material_code: String(batch.material_code),\n      material_name: String(batch.material_name),\n      allocate_qty: allocateQtyDecimal.toNumber(),\n      available_qty_before: availableQtyDecimal.toNumber(),\n      unit_cost: new Decimal(String(batch.unit_price || 0)).toNumber(),\n      inbound_date: batch.inbound_date ? String(batch.inbound_date) : '',\n      expire_date: batch.expire_date ? String(batch.expire_date) : undefined,\n      opened_at: batch.opened_at ? String(batch.opened_at) : undefined,\n      version: batch.version !== undefined ? Number(batch.version) : undefined,\n    });\n\n    remainingDecimal = remainingDecimal.minus(allocateQtyDecimal);\n    result.allocated_qty = result.allocated_qty + allocateQtyDecimal.toNumber();\n  }\n\n  result.shortage = Decimal.max(remainingDecimal, 0).toNumber();\n  result.shortage_percentage =\n    requiredQty > 0 ? new Decimal(result.shortage).dividedBy(requiredQty).times(100).toNumber() : 0;\n\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] calculateAllocation end - materialId: ${materialId}, total_available: ${result.total_available}, allocated_qty: ${result.allocated_qty}, shortage: ${result.shortage}, allocations_count: ${result.allocations.length}`\n  );\n\n  return result;\n}\n\n/**\n * FIFO 鍒嗛厤璁″垝锛堢函璁＄畻锛屼笉鍔犻攣锛塡n * 鐢ㄤ簬鍙鍦烘櫙锛氭帹鑽愭壒娆°€佸簱瀛樻煡璇㈢瓑\n */\nexport async function planFIFOAllocation(\n  conn: DbConnection,\n  materialId: number,\n  warehouseId: number,\n  requiredQty: number,\n  options: FIFOPlanOptions = {}\n): Promise<FIFOAllocationResult> {\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] planFIFOAllocation - materialId: ${materialId}, warehouseId: ${warehouseId}, requiredQty: ${requiredQty}`\n  );\n  const { sql, params } = buildBatchQuery(materialId, warehouseId, options);\n  logger.debug(`[FIFO] planFIFOAllocation SQL: ${sql}`);\n  const planRes = await conn.query(sql, params);\n  const batches: DbRow[] =\n    Array.isArray(planRes) && Array.isArray((planRes as unknown[])[0])\n      ? ((planRes as unknown[])[0] as DbRow[])\n      : (planRes as DbRow[]);\n  logger.debug(`[FIFO] planFIFOAllocation got ${batches.length} batches`);\n  return calculateAllocation(batches, materialId, requiredQty);\n}\n\n/**\n * 鎸夊厛杩涘厛鍑猴紙FIFO锛夌瓥鐣ュ垎閰嶅簱瀛樻壒娆℃暟閲忋€俓n *\n * 绠楁硶閫昏緫锛歕n * 1. 璋冪敤 planFIFOAllocation 鑾峰彇鍒嗛厤璁″垝锛堝彧璇昏绠楋級锛沑n * 2. 浣跨敤 FOR UPDATE 閿佸畾閫変腑琛岋紝闃叉骞跺彂淇敼锛沑n * 3. 杩斿洖鍒嗛厤缁撴灉锛屽寘鍚悇鎵规鍒嗛厤鏄庣粏銆俓n */\nexport async function allocateFIFO(\n  conn: DbConnection,\n  materialId: number,\n  warehouseId: number,\n  requiredQty: number,\n  options?: {\n    allowExpired?: boolean;\n    excludeBatchIds?: number[];\n  }\n): Promise<FIFOAllocationResult> {\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] allocateFIFO (with lock) - materialId: ${materialId}, warehouseId: ${warehouseId}, requiredQty: ${requiredQty}, options: ${JSON.stringify(options)}`\n  );\n  const planOptions: FIFOPlanOptions = {\n    allowExpired: options?.allowExpired,\n    excludeBatchIds: options?.excludeBatchIds,\n  };\n\n  const { sql, params } = buildBatchQuery(materialId, warehouseId, planOptions);\n  const lockedSql = sql.replace(/ORDER BY/, 'FOR UPDATE ORDER BY');\n  logger.debug(`[FIFO] allocateFIFO locked SQL: ${lockedSql}`);\n\n  const lockRes = await conn.query(lockedSql, params);\n  const batches: DbRow[] =\n    Array.isArray(lockRes) && Array.isArray((lockRes as unknown[])[0])\n      ? ((lockRes as unknown[])[0] as DbRow[])\n      : (lockRes as DbRow[]);\n  logger.debug(`[FIFO] allocateFIFO locked query got ${batches.length} batches`);\n  const result = calculateAllocation(batches, materialId, requiredQty);\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] allocateFIFO result - allocated: ${result.allocated_qty}, shortage: ${result.shortage}`\n  );\n  return result;\n}\n\n/**\n * 妫€鏌ユ寚瀹氱墿鏂欑殑搴撳瓨鏄惁瓒充互婊¤冻闇€姹傛暟閲忥紝鑻ュ瓨鍦ㄧ己鏂欏垯鐢熸垚棰勮淇℃伅銆俓n *\n * 绠楁硶閫昏緫锛歕n * 1. 鏌ヨ鐗╂枡鐨勫畨鍏ㄥ簱瀛橈紙safety_stock锛夊拰鏈€浣庡簱瀛橈紙min_stock锛屼綔涓哄啀璁㈣喘鐐癸級锛沑n * 2. 鏌ヨ鐗╂枡鎵€鏈夋湁鏁堟壒娆＄殑鍙敤閲忓悎璁★紱\n * 3. 缂烘枡閲?= max(闇€姹傞噺 - 鍙敤閲? 0)锛岃嫢缂烘枡閲忎负 0 鍒欒繑鍥?null锛堟棤闇€棰勮锛夛紱\n * 4. 寤鸿琛ヨ揣閲?= max(鍐嶈璐偣 - 鍙敤閲?+ 闇€姹傞噺, 0)锛岀‘淇濊ˉ璐у悗搴撳瓨鍥炲埌鍐嶈璐偣浠ヤ笂銆俓n *\n * @param materialId - 鐗╂枡 ID\n * @param requiredQty - 闇€姹傛暟閲廫n * @returns 缂烘枡棰勮瀵硅薄锛堝寘鍚畨鍏ㄥ簱瀛樸€佸啀璁㈣喘鐐广€佸缓璁ˉ璐ч噺绛夛級锛岃嫢鏃犵己鏂欒繑鍥?null\n */\nexport async function checkShortageAndWarn(\n  materialId: number,\n  requiredQty: number\n): Promise<ShortageWarning | null> {\n  const safetyRows = await query<DbRow>(\n    `SELECT safety_stock, min_stock FROM inv_material WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0`,\n    [materialId]\n  );\n\n  if (!safetyRows || safetyRows.length === 0) return null;\n\n  const { safety_stock, min_stock } = safetyRows[0];\n  // 鍐嶈璐偣鍙栨渶浣庡簱瀛樺€硷紙min_stock锛夛紝瀹夊叏搴撳瓨涓烘洿搴曠嚎鐨勭紦鍐查噺\n  const reorder_point = min_stock;\n  const safetyStock = parseFloat(String(safety_stock)) || 0;\n  const reorderPoint = parseFloat(String(reorder_point)) || 0;\n\n  const invRows = await query<DbRow>(\n    `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_qty), 0) as total_available FROM inv_inventory_batch\n     WHERE material_id = ? AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1`,\n    [materialId]\n  );\n\n  const availableQty = parseFloat(String(invRows[0]?.total_available)) || 0;\n  // 缂烘枡閲?= 闇€姹傞噺 - 鍙敤閲忥紙鑷冲皯涓?锛塡n  const shortageQty = Math.max(0, requiredQty - availableQty);\n\n  if (shortageQty === 0) return null;\n\n  // 寤鸿琛ヨ揣閲?= 鍐嶈璐偣 - 褰撳墠鍙敤閲?+ 鏈闇€姹傞噺锛岀‘淇濊ˉ璐у悗涓嶄綆浜庡啀璁㈣喘鐐筡n  const reorderSuggestion = Math.max(0, reorderPoint - availableQty + requiredQty);\n\n  return {\n    materialId,\n    materialCode: '',\n    materialName: '',\n    requiredQty,\n    availableQty,\n    shortageQty,\n    shortagePercentage: requiredQty > 0 ? (shortageQty / requiredQty) * 100 : 0,\n    safetyStock,\n    reorderPoint,\n    reorderSuggestion,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * 鎵ц FIFO 搴撳瓨鎵ｅ噺锛屽唴缃箰瑙傞攣鍐茬獊鑷姩閲嶈瘯鏈哄埗銆俓n *\n * 閲嶈瘯閫昏緫锛歕n * - 鑻ユ墸鍑忔椂閬囧埌涔愯閿佺増鏈啿绐侊紙閿欒淇℃伅鍖呭惈 \"宸茶鍏朵粬鎿嶄綔淇敼\"銆乗"version\" 鎴?\"affectedRows\"锛夛紝\n *   鍒欑瓑寰呯嚎鎬ч€€閬挎椂闂达紙DELAY 脳 attempts 姣锛夊悗閲嶆柊灏濊瘯锛沑n * - 闈炰箰瑙傞攣鍐茬獊鐨勯敊璇洿鎺ユ姏鍑猴紝涓嶈繘琛岄噸璇曪紱\n * - 杈惧埌鏈€澶ч噸璇曟鏁板悗浠嶆湭鎴愬姛鍒欐姏鍑烘渶缁堝け璐ュ紓甯搞€俓n *\n * @param conn - 鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ュ璞★紙闇€鍦ㄤ簨鍔′笂涓嬫枃涓娇鐢級\n * @param allocation - FIFO 鍒嗛厤缁撴灉锛屽寘鍚悇鎵规鐨勫垎閰嶆槑缁哱n * @param params - 鎵ｅ噺鍙傛暟锛屽寘鍚笟鍔℃潵婧愪俊鎭紙鍗曟嵁绫诲瀷銆佸崟鎹彿锛夊拰鎿嶄綔浜轰俊鎭痋n * @param params.sourceType - 涓氬姟鍗曟嵁绫诲瀷锛堝 \"production_order\"锛塡n * @param params.sourceId - 涓氬姟鍗曟嵁 ID\n * @param params.sourceNo - 涓氬姟鍗曟嵁鍙穃n * @param params.warehouseId - 浠撳簱 ID\n * @param params.warehouseCode - 浠撳簱缂栫爜\n * @param params.operatorId - 鎿嶄綔浜?ID锛屽彲涓?null\n * @param params.operatorName - 鎿嶄綔浜哄鍚嶏紝鍙负 null\n * @param maxRetries - 鏈€澶ч噸璇曟鏁帮紝榛樿涓?DEFAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS (3)\n * @returns 鍖呭惈鎵ｅ噺鏄庣粏鍒楄〃銆佹€绘垚鏈拰瀹為檯閲嶈瘯娆℃暟鐨勫璞n * @throws 涔愯閿佸啿绐侀噸璇曟鏁拌€楀敖鍚庢姏鍑?\"FIFO deduction failed\" 寮傚父\n * @throws 闈炰箰瑙傞攣鍐茬獊鐨勯敊璇珛鍗虫姏鍑哄師濮嬪紓甯竆n */\nexport async function executeFIFODeductionWithRetry(\n  conn: DbConnection,\n  allocation: FIFOAllocationResult,\n  params: {\n    sourceType: string;\n    sourceId: number;\n    sourceNo: string;\n    warehouseId: number;\n    warehouseCode: string;\n    operatorId: number | null;\n    operatorName: string | null;\n  },\n  maxRetries: number = DEFAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS\n): Promise<{ deductionDetails: DbRow[]; totalCost: number; attempts: number }> {\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionWithRetry start - sourceType: ${params.sourceType}, sourceNo: ${params.sourceNo}, materialId: ${allocation.material_id}, sourceId: ${params.sourceId}, maxRetries: ${maxRetries}`\n  );\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionWithRetry allocation summary - required_qty: ${allocation.required_qty}, allocated_qty: ${allocation.allocated_qty}, shortage: ${allocation.shortage}, allocations_count: ${allocation.allocations.length}`\n  );\n\n  let attempts = 0;\n  let lastError: string = '';\n\n  while (attempts < maxRetries) {\n    attempts++;\n    logger.debug(`[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionWithRetry attempt ${attempts}/${maxRetries}`);\n    try {\n      const result = await executeFIFODeductionInternal(conn, allocation, params);\n      logger.debug(\n        `[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionWithRetry success after ${attempts} attempts - totalCost: ${result.totalCost}, deductionDetails: ${result.deductionDetails.length}`\n      );\n      return { ...result, attempts };\n    } catch (error) {\n      lastError = (error as Error).message;\n      logger.debug(`[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionWithRetry attempt ${attempts} failed: ${lastError}`);\n      if (\n        attempts < maxRetries &&\n        (lastError.includes('宸茶鍏朵粬鎿嶄綔淇敼') ||\n          lastError.includes('version') ||\n          lastError.includes('affectedRows'))\n      ) {\n        logger.debug(\n          `[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionWithRetry retrying after ${DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAY_MS * attempts}ms delay...`\n        );\n        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAY_MS * attempts));\n        continue;\n      }\n      logger.debug(`[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionWithRetry throwing error (not retryable)`);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  throw new Error(`FIFO deduction failed after ${maxRetries} attempts: ${lastError}`);\n}\n\n/**\n * FIFO 鎵ｅ噺鐨勫唴閮ㄥ疄鐜帮紝閫愭壒鎵ｅ噺搴撳瓨骞惰褰曟祦姘淬€俓n *\n * 鎵ц娴佺▼锛歕n * 1. 瀵规瘡涓垎閰嶆槑缁嗛」锛屼娇鐢ㄤ箰瑙傞攣锛坴ersion 瀛楁锛夋洿鏂版壒娆¤〃鐨勫彲鐢ㄩ噺鍜屾€绘暟閲忥紱\n * 2. 鑻?affectedRows 涓?0锛屾煡璇㈠綋鍓嶆壒娆″疄闄呯増鏈彿锛屾姏鍑鸿缁嗙殑涔愯閿佸啿绐佷俊鎭紱\n * 3. 璁＄畻姣忚鎴愭湰 = 鍒嗛厤鏁伴噺 脳 鍗曚环锛堜娇鐢?Decimal 淇濊瘉绮惧害锛夛紱\n * 4. 鏌ヨ鐗╂枡鍦ㄤ粨搴撶殑褰撳墠搴撳瓨鎬婚噺锛岃绠楁墸鍑忓墠鍚庣殑搴撳瓨鍙樺寲锛沑n * 5. 鎻掑叆搴撳瓨娴佹按鏃ュ織锛坕nv_inventory_log锛夛紝璁板綍鎿嶄綔绫诲瀷銆佸墠鍚庢暟閲忋€佷笟鍔″叧鑱斾俊鎭€俓n *\n * @param conn - 鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ュ璞n * @param allocation - FIFO 鍒嗛厤缁撴灉\n * @param params - 鎵ｅ噺涓氬姟鍙傛暟\n * @returns 鍖呭惈鎵ｅ噺鏄庣粏鍒楄〃鍜屾€绘垚鏈殑瀵硅薄\n * @throws 涔愯閿佸啿绐佹椂鎶涘嚭鍚増鏈彿鍜屽彲鐢ㄩ噺鐨勮缁嗛敊璇俊鎭痋n * @throws 鎵规涓嶅瓨鍦ㄦ椂鎶涘嚭 \"FIFO搴撳瓨鏇存柊澶辫触\" 寮傚父\n */\nasync function executeFIFODeductionInternal(\n  conn: DbConnection,\n  allocation: FIFOAllocationResult,\n  params: {\n    sourceType: string;\n    sourceId: number;\n    sourceNo: string;\n    warehouseId: number;\n    warehouseCode: string;\n    operatorId: number | null;\n    operatorName: string | null;\n  }\n): Promise<{ deductionDetails: DbRow[]; totalCost: number }> {\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionInternal start - materialId: ${allocation.material_id}, sourceNo: ${params.sourceNo}`\n  );\n  const deductionDetails: DbRow[] = [];\n  let totalCostDecimal = new Decimal(0);\n\n  for (const alloc of allocation.allocations) {\n    logger.debug(\n      `[FIFO]   processing batch: batch_id=${alloc.batch_id}, batch_no=${alloc.batch_no}, allocate_qty=${alloc.allocate_qty}, available_qty_before=${alloc.available_qty_before}, version=${alloc.version}, unit_cost=${alloc.unit_cost}`\n    );\n\n    // 浣跨敤涔愯閿佹洿鏂帮細WHERE 鏉′欢鍖呭惈 version 瀛楁锛岄槻姝㈠苟鍙戜慨鏀瑰鑷磋秴鎵n    const [updateResult]: DbResult = await conn.execute(\n      `UPDATE inv_inventory_batch SET\n        quantity = quantity - ?,\n        available_qty = available_qty - ?,\n        version = version + 1,\n        update_time = NOW()\n      WHERE id = ? AND available_qty >= ? AND version = ?`,\n      [alloc.allocate_qty, alloc.allocate_qty, alloc.batch_id, alloc.allocate_qty, alloc.version]\n    );\n\n    const result = updateResult as unknown as DbResultSetHeader;\n    logger.debug(\n      `[FIFO]   batch ${alloc.batch_no} UPDATE result - affectedRows: ${result.affectedRows}`\n    );\n\n    if (result.affectedRows === 0) {\n      // 涔愯閿佸啿绐侊細鏌ヨ褰撳墠鎵规瀹為檯鐘舵€侊紝鐢ㄤ簬鐢熸垚璇︾粏閿欒淇℃伅\n      const [currentBatch]: DbResult = await conn.query(\n        'SELECT version, available_qty FROM inv_inventory_batch WHERE id = ?',\n        [alloc.batch_id]\n      );\n      logger.debug(\n        `[FIFO]   batch ${alloc.batch_no} optimistic lock conflict - currentBatch: ${JSON.stringify(currentBatch)}`\n      );\n      if (currentBatch.length > 0) {\n        throw new Error(\n          `鎵规${alloc.batch_no}涔愯閿佸啿绐? 鏈熸湜鐗堟湰${alloc.version}, ` +\n            `瀹為檯鐗堟湰${currentBatch[0].version}, 鍙敤閲?{currentBatch[0].available_qty}`\n        );\n      }\n      throw new Error(`FIFO搴撳瓨鏇存柊澶辫触: 鎵规${alloc.batch_no}锛屽彲鑳藉凡琚叾浠栨搷浣滀慨鏀筦);\n    }\n\n    // 琛屾垚鏈?= 鍒嗛厤鏁伴噺 脳 鍗曚环锛圖ecimal 杩愮畻閬垮厤娴偣璇樊锛塡n    const lineCostDecimal = new Decimal(alloc.allocate_qty).times(alloc.unit_cost);\n    totalCostDecimal = totalCostDecimal.plus(lineCostDecimal);\n    logger.debug(\n      `[FIFO]   batch ${alloc.batch_no} cost calculated - line_cost: ${lineCostDecimal.toNumber()}, totalCost so far: ${totalCostDecimal.toNumber()}`\n    );\n\n    deductionDetails.push({\n      batch_id: alloc.batch_id,\n      batch_no: alloc.batch_no,\n      material_id: alloc.material_id,\n      material_name: alloc.material_name,\n      deducted_qty: alloc.allocate_qty,\n      unit_cost: alloc.unit_cost,\n      line_cost: lineCostDecimal.toNumber(),\n      mode: 'fifo_auto',\n    });\n\n    // 鏌ヨ鐗╂枡鍦ㄤ粨搴撶殑褰撳墠搴撳瓨鎬婚噺锛岀敤浜庤褰曞簱瀛樻祦姘寸殑鍓嶅悗鍙樺寲\n    const [currentInv]: DbResult = await conn.query(\n      'SELECT quantity FROM inv_inventory WHERE material_id = ? AND warehouse_id = ? AND deleted = 0',\n      [alloc.material_id, params.warehouseId]\n    );\n    const beforeQty = currentInv.length > 0 ? parseFloat(String(currentInv[0].quantity)) : 0;\n    const afterQty = beforeQty - alloc.allocate_qty;\n\n    logger.debug(\n      `[FIFO]   batch ${alloc.batch_no} inventory log - before_qty: ${beforeQty}, after_qty: ${afterQty}`\n    );\n\n    await appendInventoryLog(conn, {\n      materialId: alloc.material_id,\n      warehouseId: params.warehouseId,\n      batchNo: alloc.batch_no,\n      operationType: 2,\n      operationQty: alloc.allocate_qty,\n      beforeQty,\n      afterQty,\n      businessType: params.sourceType,\n      businessNo: params.sourceNo,\n      remark: `FIFO鍑哄簱-鎵规${alloc.batch_no}`,\n      operatorId: params.operatorId,\n    });\n\n    logger.debug(`[FIFO]   batch ${alloc.batch_no} deduction completed successfully`);\n  }\n\n  logger.debug(\n    `[FIFO] executeFIFODeductionInternal end - totalCost: ${totalCostDecimal.toNumber()}, deductionDetails: ${deductionDetails.length} items`\n  );\n  return { deductionDetails, totalCost: totalCostDecimal.toNumber() };\n}\n\n/**\n * 鍦ㄤ簨鍔′腑鎵归噺鎵ц澶氫釜鐗╂枡鐨?FIFO 鍒嗛厤涓庢墸鍑忔搷浣溿€俓n *\n * 鎵ц娴佺▼锛歕n * 1. 寮€鍚暟鎹簱浜嬪姟锛沑n * 2. 瀵规瘡涓墿鏂欎緷娆¤皟鐢?allocateFIFO 杩涜鍒嗛厤锛沑n * 3. 鑻ュ瓨鍦ㄧ己鏂欙紝璋冪敤 checkShortageAndWarn 鐢熸垚棰勮骞惰ˉ鍏呯墿鏂欑紪鐮?鍚嶇О锛沑n * 4. 瀵规湁鍒嗛厤鏄庣粏鐨勭墿鏂欒皟鐢?executeFIFODeductionWithRetry 鎵ц鎵ｅ噺锛堝惈涔愯閿侀噸璇曪級锛沑n * 5. 浣跨敤 Decimal 绱姞鎵€鏈夌墿鏂欑殑鎬绘垚鏈紱\n * 6. 浜嬪姟鎴愬姛鍒欒繑鍥炲叏閮ㄧ粨鏋滐紝澶辫触鍒欏洖婊氬苟杩斿洖閿欒淇℃伅銆俓n *\n * @param allocations - 澶氱墿鏂欑殑鍒嗛厤璇锋眰鍒楄〃锛屾瘡椤瑰寘鍚墿鏂?ID銆佷粨搴?ID銆侀渶姹傛暟閲忓拰鍙€夋帓闄ゆ壒娆n * @param params - 鎵ｅ噺涓氬姟鍙傛暟锛屽寘鍚崟鎹俊鎭拰鎿嶄綔浜轰俊鎭痋n * @param params.sourceType - 涓氬姟鍗曟嵁绫诲瀷\n * @param params.sourceId - 涓氬姟鍗曟嵁 ID\n * @param params.sourceNo - 涓氬姟鍗曟嵁鍙穃n * @param params.warehouseCode - 浠撳簱缂栫爜\n * @param params.operatorId - 鎿嶄綔浜?ID锛屽彲涓?null\n * @param params.operatorName - 鎿嶄綔浜哄鍚嶏紝鍙负 null\n * @returns 鍖呭惈鎵€鏈夌墿鏂欏垎閰嶇粨鏋溿€佹€绘垚鏈€佺己鏂欓璀﹀垪琛ㄥ強鎴愬姛鏍囧織鐨勫璞★紱\n *          浜嬪姟澶辫触鏃?success 涓?false 骞堕檮甯?error 淇℃伅\n */\nexport async function executeFIFOWithTransaction(\n  allocations: Array<{\n    materialId: number;\n    warehouseId: number;\n    requiredQty: number;\n    excludeBatchIds?: number[];\n  }>,\n  params: {\n    sourceType: string;\n    sourceId: number;\n    sourceNo: string;\n    warehouseCode: string;\n    operatorId: number | null;\n    operatorName: string | null;\n  }\n): Promise<{\n  results: FIFOAllocationResult[];\n  totalCost: number;\n  shortageWarnings: ShortageWarning[];\n  success: boolean;\n  error?: string;\n}> {\n  const results: FIFOAllocationResult[] = [];\n  const shortageWarnings: ShortageWarning[] = [];\n  let totalCostDecimal = new Decimal(0);\n\n  try {\n    const finalResult = await transaction(async (conn) => {\n      for (const alloc of allocations) {\n        const allocation = await allocateFIFO(\n          conn,\n          alloc.materialId,\n          alloc.warehouseId,\n          alloc.requiredQty,\n          {\n            excludeBatchIds: alloc.excludeBatchIds,\n          }\n        );\n\n        if (allocation.shortage > 0) {\n          const warning = await checkShortageAndWarn(alloc.materialId, alloc.requiredQty);\n          if (warning) {\n            warning.materialCode = allocation.material_code;\n            warning.materialName = allocation.material_name;\n            shortageWarnings.push(warning);\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (allocation.allocations.length > 0) {\n          const deductionResult = await executeFIFODeductionWithRetry(conn, allocation, {\n            sourceType: params.sourceType,\n            sourceId: params.sourceId,\n            sourceNo: params.sourceNo,\n            warehouseId: alloc.warehouseId,\n            warehouseCode: params.warehouseCode,\n            operatorId: params.operatorId,\n            operatorName: params.operatorName,\n          });\n          totalCostDecimal = totalCostDecimal.plus(deductionResult.totalCost);\n        }\n\n        results.push(allocation);\n      }\n\n      return {\n        results,\n        totalCost: totalCostDecimal.toNumber(),\n        shortageWarnings,\n        success: true,\n      };\n    });\n\n    return finalResult;\n  } catch (error) {\n    return {\n      results,\n      totalCost: totalCostDecimal.toNumber(),\n      shortageWarnings,\n      success: false,\n      error: (error as Error).message,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 鎸囧畾鎵规鍑哄簱鎵ｅ噺锛岃烦杩?FIFO 鑷姩鍒嗛厤锛岀洿鎺ヤ粠鐢ㄦ埛鎸囧畾鐨勬壒娆℃墸鍑忓簱瀛樸€俓n *\n * 鎵ц娴佺▼锛歕n * 1. 鏌ヨ鎸囧畾鎵规骞跺姞琛岄攣锛團OR UPDATE锛夛紝闃叉骞跺彂淇敼锛沑n * 2. 鏍￠獙鎵规鍙敤閲忔槸鍚?>= 闇€姹傛暟閲忥紝涓嶈冻鍒欐姏鍑哄紓甯革紱\n * 3. 浣跨敤涔愯閿侊紙version 瀛楁锛夋洿鏂版壒娆¤〃鐨勫彲鐢ㄩ噺鍜屾€绘暟閲忥紱\n * 4. 鑻?affectedRows 涓?0锛岃鏄庡苟鍙戝啿绐侊紝鎶涘嚭寮傚父锛沑n * 5. 璁＄畻鎬绘垚鏈?= 闇€姹傛暟閲?脳 鍗曚环锛圖ecimal 绮惧害杩愮畻锛夛紱\n * 6. AND warehouse_id = ? AND deleted = 0\n    `;\n    const params: Loose[] = [materialId, warehouseId];\n\n    if (batchNo) {\n      sql += ' AND batch_no = ?';\n      params.push(batchNo);\n    }\n\n    let rows: Loose;\n    if (conn) {\n      const [result] = await conn.execute(sql, params);\n      rows = result as Loose;\n    } else {\n      rows = await query(sql, params);\n    }\n\n    if (rows.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        message: `鐗╂枡ID ${materialId} 鍦ㄤ粨搴?${warehouseId} 鏃犲簱瀛樿褰昤,\n        currentStock: 0,\n        availableStock: 0,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const stock = rows[0];\n    const availableQty = parseFloat(stock.available_qty || '0');\n\n    if (availableQty < requiredQty) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        message: `搴撳瓨涓嶈冻: 鍙敤 ${availableQty}, 闇€瑕?${requiredQty}`,\n        currentStock: parseFloat(stock.quantity || '0'),\n        availableStock: availableQty,\n      };\n    }\n\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      message: '搴撳瓨鍏呰冻',\n      currentStock: parseFloat(stock.quantity || '0'),\n      availableStock: availableQty,\n    };\n  } catch (error) {\n    secureLog('error', '搴撳瓨妫€鏌ュけ璐?, {\n      error: (error as Error).message,\n      materialId,\n      warehouseId,\n    });\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      message: '搴撳瓨妫€鏌ュ紓甯革紝璇风◢鍚庨噸璇?,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 璋冩暣搴撳瓨锛堢粺涓€鍏ュ彛锛塡n * 姣忔璋冩暣鑷姩璁板綍搴撳瓨娴佹按\n * @param conn - 璁＄畻寮曟搸锛屾敮鎸佸畬鏁寸殑鐗╂枡闇€姹傝鍒掓祦绋嬶細\n * 1. 鏀堕泦姣涢渶姹傦紙閿€鍞鍗曪級\n * 2. 澶氬眰绾?BOM 灞曞紑锛岄€愮骇浼犻€掍緷璧栭渶姹俓n * 3. 鏃堕棿鍒嗘渚涢渶骞宠　璁＄畻\n * 4. 浜ц兘璐熻嵎鍒嗘瀽\n *\n * 浣跨敤鏂瑰紡锛歕n * ```typescript\n * const engine = new MRPEngine({ horizonDays: 90, bucketSize: 'week' });\n * const result = await engine.run({\n *   runType: 'full',\n *   planStartDate: '2024-01-01',\n *   warehouseId: 1,\n *   productIds: [101, 102]\n * });\n * ```\n */\nexport class MRPEngine {\n  private config: MRPConfig;\n  private conn: PoolConnection | null;\n  private warnings: string[] = [];\n\n  /**\n   * 鍒涘缓 MRP 寮曟搸瀹炰緥\n   *\n   * @param config - 鍙€夛紝閮ㄥ垎 MRP 閰嶇疆鍙傛暟锛屾湭鎸囧畾鐨勪娇鐢ㄩ粯璁ゅ€糪n   * @param conn - 鍙€夛紝澶栭儴鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ワ紝涓嶄紶鍒?run 鏃惰嚜鍔ㄨ幏鍙朶n   */\n  constructor(config?: Partial<MRPConfig>, conn?: PoolConnection) {\n    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };\n    this.conn = conn || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 鎵ц MRP 璁＄畻\n   *\n   * 瀹屾暣鎵ц涓€娆?MRP 杩愮畻锛屽寘鎷細\n   * 1. 鐢熸垚杩愯缂栧彿\n   * 2. 鏀堕泦閿€鍞鍗曟瘺闇€姹俓n   * 3. 澶氬眰绾х墿鏂欏睍寮€锛岄€愮骇璁＄畻渚涢渶骞宠　\n   * 4. 浜ц兘璐熻嵎鍒嗘瀽\n   * 5. 姹囨€荤粺璁★紙璁″垝璁㈠崟鏁般€侀噰璐敵璇锋暟銆佸伐鍗曟暟锛塡n   *\n   * @param params - MRP 杩愯鍙傛暟\n   * @returns MRP 杩愯瀹屾暣缁撴灉锛屽寘鍚墿鏂欏垎鏋愩€佷骇鑳借礋鑽峰拰璀﹀憡淇℃伅\n   */\n  async run(params: MRPRunParams): Promise<MRPRunResult> {\n    const startTime = new Date();\n    this.warnings = [];\n\n    const conn = this.conn || (await getConnection());\n    const isExternalConn = !!this.conn;\n\n    try {\n      const planStartDate = params.planStartDate || formatDateStr(new Date());\n      const horizonDays = this.config.horizonDays;\n      const endDate = new Date(planStartDate + 'T00:00:00');\n      endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + horizonDays - 1);\n      const planEndDate = formatDateStr(endDate);\n\n      const runNo = await generateDocumentNo('mrp_run');\n\n      const demands = await this.collectGrossRequirements(\n        conn,\n        planStartDate,\n        planEndDate,\n        params.productIds\n      );\n\n      const productIds = [...new Set(demands.map((d) => d.materialId))];\n\n      const materials = await this.processAllMaterials(\n        conn,\n        demands,\n        planStartDate,\n        horizonDays,\n        params.warehouseId\n      );\n\n      const capacityLoads = await this.calculateCapacityRequired(\n        conn,\n        materials,\n        planStartDate,\n        horizonDays\n      );\n\n      let plannedOrderCount = 0;\n      let purchaseReqCount = 0;\n      let workOrderCount = 0;\n\n      for (const m of materials) {\n        for (const b of m.buckets) {\n          if (b.plannedOrderRelease > 0) {\n            plannedOrderCount++;\n            if (b.actionType === 'produce') {\n              workOrderCount++;\n            } else if (b.actionType === 'purchase') {\n              purchaseReqCount++;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      return {\n        runId: 0,\n        runNo,\n        status: 'completed',\n        materialCount: materials.length,\n        productCount: productIds.length,\n        plannedOrderCount,\n        purchaseReqCount,\n        workOrderCount,\n        materials,\n        capacityLoads,\n        warnings: this.warnings,\n        startTime,\n        endTime: new Date(),\n      };\n    } finally {\n      if (!isExternalConn && conn && conn.release) {\n        conn.release();\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async collectGrossRequirements(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    startDate: string,\n    endDate: string,\n    productIds?: number[]\n  ): Promise<\n    {\n      materialId: number;\n      materialCode: string;\n      materialName: string;\n      quantity: number;\n      dueDate: string;\n      sourceType: string;\n      sourceId: number;\n      sourceNo: string;\n    }[]\n  > {\n    const demands: {\n      materialId: number;\n      materialCode: string;\n      materialName: string;\n      quantity: number;\n      dueDate: string;\n      sourceType: string;\n      sourceId: number;\n      sourceNo: string;\n    }[] = [];\n\n    let sql = `\n      SELECT \n        so.id as source_id,\n        so.order_no as source_no,\n        sod.product_id as material_id,\n        im.material_code,\n        im.material_name,\n        sod.quantity,\n        so.delivery_date as due_date\n      FROM sal_order so\n      INNER JOIN sal_order_detail sod ON sod.order_id = so.id\n      INNER JOIN inv_material im ON im.id = sod.product_id\n      WHERE so.deleted = 0\n        AND sod.deleted = 0\n        AND so.status IN (1, 2)\n        AND so.delivery_date BETWEEN ? AND ?\n    `;\n\n    const params: (string | number)[] = [startDate, endDate];\n\n    if (productIds && productIds.length > 0) {\n      sql += ` AND sod.product_id IN (${productIds.map(() => '?').join(',')})`;\n      params.push(...productIds);\n    }\n\n    sql += ` ORDER BY so.delivery_date`;\n\n    const [rows] = await conn.query<GrossRequirementRow[]>(sql, params);\n\n    for (const row of rows) {\n      demands.push({\n        materialId: Number(row.material_id),\n        materialCode: row.material_code || '',\n        materialName: row.material_name || '',\n        quantity: Number(row.quantity || 0),\n        dueDate: formatDateStr(row.due_date),\n        sourceType: 'sales_order',\n        sourceId: Number(row.source_id),\n        sourceNo: row.source_no || '',\n      });\n    }\n\n    secureLog('info', `MRP鏀堕泦闇€姹傚畬鎴恅, {\n      demandCount: demands.length,\n      dateRange: `${startDate} ~ ${endDate}`,\n    });\n\n    return demands;\n  }\n\n  private async processAllMaterials(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    demands: { materialId: number; quantity: number; dueDate: string }[],\n    startDate: string,\n    horizonDays: number,\n    warehouseId?: number\n  ): Promise<MRPMaterialResult[]> {\n    const materialMap = new Map<number, MRPMaterialResult>();\n    const processed = new Set<number>();\n\n    const demandMap = new Map<number, Map<string, number>>();\n    for (const d of demands) {\n      if (!demandMap.has(d.materialId)) {\n        demandMap.set(d.materialId, new Map());\n      }\n      const dateMap = demandMap.get(d.materialId)!;\n      dateMap.set(d.dueDate, (dateMap.get(d.dueDate) || 0) + d.quantity);\n    }\n\n    const productIds = [...demandMap.keys()];\n    const queue = [...productIds];\n    const levelMap = new Map<number, number>();\n    for (const pid of productIds) {\n      levelMap.set(pid, 0);\n    }\n\n    while (queue.length > 0) {\n      const materialId = queue.shift()!;\n\n      if (processed.has(materialId)) continue;\n      processed.add(materialId);\n\n      const materialInfo = await this.getMaterialInfo(conn, materialId);\n      if (!materialInfo) {\n        this.warnings.push(`鐗╂枡ID ${materialId} 涓嶅瓨鍦紝璺宠繃`);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const demandDates = demandMap.get(materialId) || new Map();\n      const buckets = await this.calculateMaterialBuckets(\n        conn,\n        materialId,\n        materialInfo,\n        demandDates,\n        startDate,\n        horizonDays,\n        warehouseId\n      );\n\n      // 澶栬喘鐗╂枡鏍囪涓?purchase锛岃嚜鍒朵欢鏍囪涓?produce 鍚庣画灞曞紑瀛愪欢\n      const isPurchase = materialInfo.material_type === 'purchase';\n      const actionType: MRPActionType = isPurchase ? 'purchase' : 'produce';\n\n      for (const bucket of buckets) {\n        bucket.actionType = actionType;\n      }\n\n      const materialResult: MRPMaterialResult = {\n        materialId,\n        materialCode: materialInfo.material_code,\n        materialName: materialInfo.material_name,\n        materialType: isPurchase\n          ? 'material'\n          : materialInfo.material_type === 'semi'\n            ? 'semi'\n            : 'product',\n        unit: materialInfo.unit,\n        safetyStock: Number(materialInfo.safety_stock || 0),\n        leadTimeDays: Number(\n          materialInfo.lead_time_days ||\n            (await CalcParamService.getInt('mrp.default_lead_time_days', 7))\n        ),\n        lotSizing: this.config.defaultLotSizing,\n        fixedLotSize: this.config.defaultFixedLotSize,\n        buckets,\n        totalGross: buckets.reduce((s, b) => s + b.grossRequirement, 0),\n        totalNet: buckets.reduce((s, b) => s + b.netRequirement, 0),\n        totalPlanned: buckets.reduce((s, b) => s + b.plannedOrderReceipt, 0),\n        endOnHand: buckets.length > 0 ? buckets[buckets.length - 1].onHandInventory : 0,\n      };\n\n      materialMap.set(materialId, materialResult);\n\n      // 鑷埗浠堕渶瑕佸睍寮€ BOM锛屽皢璁″垝涓嬭揪閲忎綔涓轰笅绾у瓙浠剁殑姣涢渶姹俓n      if (!isPurchase) {\n        const children = await this.getBOMChildren(conn, materialId);\n        for (const child of children) {\n          if (!processed.has(child.material_id)) {\n            queue.push(child.material_id);\n          }\n\n          const childDemandMap = demandMap.get(child.material_id) || new Map();\n          for (const bucket of buckets) {\n            if (bucket.plannedOrderRelease > 0) {\n              // 瀛愪欢姣涢渶姹?= 璁″垝涓嬭揪閲?脳 鍗曚綅鐢ㄩ噺 脳 (1 + 鎹熻€楃巼/100)\n              const childQty =\n                bucket.plannedOrderRelease * child.consumption_qty * (1 + child.loss_rate / 100);\n              childDemandMap.set(\n                bucket.bucketDate,\n                (childDemandMap.get(bucket.bucketDate) || 0) + childQty\n              );\n            }\n          }\n          demandMap.set(child.material_id, childDemandMap);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return Array.from(materialMap.values()).sort((a, b) =>\n      a.materialCode.localeCompare(b.materialCode)\n    );\n  }\n\n  private async calculateMaterialBuckets(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    materialId: number,\n    materialInfo: MaterialInfoRow,\n    demandDates: Map<string, number>,\n    startDate: string,\n    horizonDays: number,\n    warehouseId?: number\n  ): Promise<MRPTimeBucket[]> {\n    const buckets = generateBucketDates(startDate, horizonDays, this.config.bucketSize);\n    const result: MRPTimeBucket[] = [];\n\n    const safetyStock = calculateSafetyStock(\n      this.config.safetyStockPolicy,\n      Number(materialInfo.safety_stock || 0),\n      this.calculateAvgDailyDemand(demandDates, horizonDays),\n      this.config.defaultSafetyStockDays\n    );\n\n    const currentOnHand = await this.getCurrentInventory(conn, materialId, warehouseId);\n\n    const scheduledReceipts = await this.getScheduledReceipts(\n      conn,\n      materialId,\n      startDate,\n      horizonDays,\n      warehouseId\n    );\n\n    const leadTimeDays = Number(\n      materialInfo.lead_time_days ||\n        (await CalcParamService.getInt('mrp.default_lead_time_days', 7))\n    );\n    const lotSizing = materialInfo.lot_sizing || this.config.defaultLotSizing;\n    const fixedLotSize = Number(materialInfo.fixed_lot_size || this.config.defaultFixedLotSize);\n\n    // 婊氬姩鍦ㄦ墜搴撳瓨 = 褰撳墠搴撳瓨 - 瀹夊叏搴撳瓨\n    let runningOnHand = currentOnHand - safetyStock;\n\n    for (const bucket of buckets) {\n      let grossReq = 0;\n      let schedReceipt = 0;\n\n      // 姹囨€昏鍒嗘鍐呮墍鏈夋棩鏈熺殑姣涢渶姹傚拰璁″垝鏀惰揣\n      for (const d of bucket.dates) {\n        grossReq += demandDates.get(d) || 0;\n        schedReceipt += scheduledReceipts.get(d) || 0;\n      }\n\n      // 璁″垝鍓嶅湪鎵嬪簱瀛?= 婊氬姩鎵嬪湪 + 璁″垝鏀惰揣 - 姣涢渶姹俓n      const projectedOnHandBefore = runningOnHand + schedReceipt - grossReq;\n\n      let netReq = 0;\n      let plannedReceipt = 0;\n\n      // 鑻ヨ鍒掑墠鍦ㄦ墜搴撳瓨涓鸿礋锛屽垯浜х敓鍑€闇€姹傦紝闇€搴旂敤鎵归噺鍖栬鍒橽n      if (projectedOnHandBefore < 0) {\n        netReq = Math.abs(projectedOnHandBefore);\n        plannedReceipt = applyLotSizing(netReq, lotSizing, fixedLotSize);\n      }\n\n      const onHandAfter = runningOnHand + schedReceipt - grossReq + plannedReceipt;\n\n      result.push({\n        bucketDate: bucket.bucketDate,\n        grossRequirement: round4(grossReq),\n        scheduledReceipt: round4(schedReceipt),\n        onHandInventory: round4(Math.max(0, onHandAfter + safetyStock)),\n        netRequirement: round4(netReq),\n        plannedOrderReceipt: round4(plannedReceipt),\n        plannedOrderRelease: 0,\n      });\n\n      runningOnHand = onHandAfter;\n    }\n\n    // 鏍规嵁鎻愬墠鏈熷墠绉昏鍒掕鍗曪細鎺ユ敹鏃ユ湡鐨勬椂闂村垎娈?-> 閲婃斁鏃ユ湡鐨勬椂闂村垎娈礬n    for (let i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {\n      if (result[i].plannedOrderReceipt > 0) {\n        const releaseBucketIdx = this.findReleaseBucketIndex(i, leadTimeDays, buckets);\n        if (releaseBucketIdx >= 0) {\n          result[releaseBucketIdx].plannedOrderRelease = result[i].plannedOrderReceipt;\n        } else {\n          result[0].plannedOrderRelease += result[i].plannedOrderReceipt;\n          this.warnings.push(\n            `鐗╂枡 ${materialInfo.material_code} 璁″垝浜у嚭鏃ユ湡 ${result[i].bucketDate} 鎻愬墠鏈?${leadTimeDays} 澶╄秴鍑鸿鍒掑紑濮嬫棩鏈燂紝鎻愬墠鏈熶笉瓒砢\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  private findReleaseBucketIndex(\n    receiptBucketIdx: number,\n    leadTimeDays: number,\n    buckets: { bucketDate: string; start: Date; end: Date; dates: string[] }[]\n  ): number {\n    if (receiptBucketIdx < 0) return -1;\n\n    const receiptDate = new Date(buckets[receiptBucketIdx].bucketDate + 'T00:00:00');\n    const releaseDate = new Date(receiptDate);\n    releaseDate.setDate(releaseDate.getDate() - leadTimeDays);\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {\n      if (releaseDate >= buckets[i].start && releaseDate <= buckets[i].end) {\n        return i;\n      }\n      if (releaseDate < buckets[i].start) {\n        return i - 1;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return -1;\n  }\n\n  private async getMaterialInfo(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    materialId: number\n  ): Promise<MaterialInfoRow | null> {\n    const [rows] = await conn.query<MaterialInfoRow[]>(\n      `SELECT \n         im.id, im.material_code, im.material_name, im.unit, \n         im.safety_stock, im.lead_time_days, im.material_type,\n         im.purchase_price, im.order_cost, im.holding_cost_rate,\n         im.lot_sizing, im.fixed_lot_size, im.eoq,\n         im.period_supply_days\n       FROM inv_material im \n       WHERE im.id = ? AND im.deleted = 0`,\n      [materialId]\n    );\n    return rows.length > 0 ? rows[0] : null;\n  }\n\n  private async getCurrentInventory(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    materialId: number,\n    warehouseId?: number\n  ): Promise<number> {\n    let sql = `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_qty), 0) as total\n               FROM inv_inventory\n               WHERE material_id = ? AND deleted = 0`;\n    const params: (string | number)[] = [materialId];\n\n    if (warehouseId) {\n      sql += ` AND warehouse_id = ?`;\n      params.push(warehouseId);\n    }\n\n    const [rows] = await conn.query<InventoryTotalRow[]>(sql, params);\n    return Number(rows.length > 0 ? rows[0].total || 0 : 0);\n  }\n\n  private async getScheduledReceipts(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    materialId: number,\n    startDate: string,\n    horizonDays: number,\n    _warehouseId?: number\n  ): Promise<Map<string, number>> {\n    const receiptMap = new Map<string, number>();\n\n    const endDate = new Date(startDate + 'T00:00:00');\n    endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + horizonDays - 1);\n    const endDateStr = formatDateStr(endDate);\n\n    if (this.config.considerInTransit) {\n      const poSql = `\n        SELECT DATE(po.delivery_date) as receipt_date,\n               COALESCE(SUM(pol.order_qty - pol.received_qty), 0) as qty\n        FROM pur_purchase_order po\n        INNER JOIN pur_purchase_order_line pol ON pol.po_id = po.id\n        WHERE pol.material_id = ?\n          AND po.deleted = 0\n          AND po.status IN (20, 30)\n          AND po.delivery_date BETWEEN ? AND ?\n          AND pol.order_qty > pol.received_qty\n        GROUP BY DATE(po.delivery_date)\n      `;\n      const [poRows] = await conn.query<ScheduledReceiptRow[]>(poSql, [\n        materialId,\n        startDate,\n        endDateStr,\n      ]);\n      for (const row of poRows) {\n        const d = formatDateStr(row.receipt_date);\n        receiptMap.set(d, (receiptMap.get(d) || 0) + Number(row.qty || 0));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (this.config.considerWorkInProcess) {\n      const woSql = `\n        SELECT DATE(wo.plan_finish_date) as receipt_date,\n               COALESCE(SUM(wo.quantity - wo.finished_qty), 0) as qty\n        FROM prod_work_order wo\n        WHERE wo.product_id = ?\n          AND wo.deleted = 0\n          AND wo.status IN (1, 2, 3)\n          AND wo.plan_finish_date BETWEEN ? AND ?\n          AND wo.quantity > wo.finished_qty\n        GROUP BY DATE(wo.plan_finish_date)\n      `;\n      const [woRows] = await conn.query<ScheduledReceiptRow[]>(woSql, [\n        materialId,\n        startDate,\n        endDateStr,\n      ]);\n      for (const row of woRows) {\n        const d = formatDateStr(row.receipt_date);\n        receiptMap.set(d, (receiptMap.get(d) || 0) + Number(row.qty || 0));\n      }\n    }\n\n    return receiptMap;\n  }\n\n  private async getBOMChildren(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    productId: number\n  ): Promise<{ material_id: number; consumption_qty: number; loss_rate: number }[]> {\n    const [rows] = await conn.query<BomChildRow[]>(\n      `SELECT bl.material_id, bl.consumption_qty, bl.loss_rate\n       FROM bom_header bh\n       INNER JOIN bom_line bl ON bl.bom_id = bh.id\n       WHERE bh.product_id = ? \n         AND bh.status = 30 \n         AND bh.deleted = 0\n         AND bl.deleted = 0\n       ORDER BY bh.is_default DESC, bh.version DESC\n       LIMIT 100`,\n      [productId]\n    );\n    return rows.map((r) => ({\n      material_id: Number(r.material_id),\n      consumption_qty: Number(r.consumption_qty || 0),\n      loss_rate: Number(r.loss_rate || 0),\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private calculateAvgDailyDemand(demandDates: Map<string, number>, horizonDays: number): number {\n    let total = 0;\n    for (const qty of demandDates.values()) {\n      total += qty;\n    }\n    return horizonDays > 0 ? total / horizonDays : 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 璁＄畻浜ц兘璐熻嵎闇€姹俓n   *\n   * 閬嶅巻鎵€鏈夐潪閲囪喘鐗╂枡锛堜骇鍝?鍗婃垚鍝侊級鐨勮鍒掕鍗曪紝鏍规嵁宸ヨ壓璺嚎璁＄畻鍚勫伐浣嶄腑蹇冪殑\n   * 鏍囧噯宸ユ椂闇€姹傘€傝礋鑽风巼 = 闇€姹傚伐鏃?/ 鏍囧噯浜ц兘锛岃礋鑽风巼 > 1 琛ㄧず瓒呰礋鑽枫€俓n   *\n   * @param conn - 鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺n   * @param materials - 鎵€鏈夌墿鏂欑殑 MRP 鍒嗘瀽缁撴灉\n   * @param startDate - 璁＄畻璧峰鏃ユ湡\n   * @param horizonDays - 璁＄畻鑼冨洿澶╂暟\n   * @returns 鍚勫伐浣滀腑蹇冩寜鏃ユ湡姹囨€荤殑浜ц兘璐熻嵎鍒嗘瀽\n   */\n  async calculateCapacityRequired(\n    conn: PoolConnection,\n    materials: MRPMaterialResult[],\n    startDate: string,\n    horizonDays: number\n  ): Promise<CapacityLoad[]> {\n    const capacityMap = new Map<string, CapacityLoad>();\n    const _buckets = generateBucketDates(startDate, horizonDays, this.config.bucketSize);\n\n    const productMaterials = materials.filter((m) => m.materialType !== 'material');\n\n    for (const m of productMaterials) {\n      for (const bucket of m.buckets) {\n        if (bucket.plannedOrderRelease <= 0) continue;\n\n        const [processRows] = await conn.query<ProcessRouteCapacityRow[]>(\n          `SELECT pr.work_center_id, wc.work_center_code, wc.work_center_name,\n                  pr.standard_hours, wc.daily_capacity\n           FROM pro_process_route pr\n           INNER JOIN pro_work_center wc ON wc.id = pr.work_center_id\n           WHERE pr.product_id = ? AND pr.status = 1\n           ORDER BY pr.seq_no`,\n          [m.materialId]\n        );\n\n        for (const pr of processRows) {\n          // 闇€姹傚伐鏃?= 璁″垝鐢熶骇鏁伴噺 脳 鏍囧噯宸ユ椂\n          const 10\n): Promise<BOMNode> {\n  const productRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT id, material_code, material_name, unit FROM inv_material WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0`,\n    [productId]\n  );\n\n  let productCode = '';\n  let productName = '';\n  let productUnit = '浠?;\n\n  if (productRows.length > 0) {\n    productCode = productRows[0].material_code || '';\n    productName = productRows[0].material_name || '';\n    productUnit = productRows[0].unit || '浠?;\n  }\n\n  const defaultLeadTime = await CalcParamService.getInt('mrp.default_lead_time_days', 7);\n  const leadTimeRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT id FROM inv_material WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0`,\n    [productId]\n  );\n  const rootLeadTime = leadTimeRows.length > 0 ? defaultLeadTime : defaultLeadTime;\n\n  const root: BOMNode = {\n    material_id: productId,\n    material_code: productCode,\n    material_name: productName,\n    quantity: quantity,\n    unit: productUnit,\n    level: 0,\n    path: String(productId),\n    is_leaf: true,\n    lead_time_days: rootLeadTime,\n    scrap_rate: 0,\n    children: [],\n  };\n\n  const stack: StackItem[] = [\n    {\n      material_id: productId,\n      material_code: productCode,\n      material_name: productName,\n      quantity: quantity,\n      unit: productUnit,\n      level: 0,\n      path: String(productId),\n      parent_node: root,\n      parent_qty: quantity,\n    },\n  ];\n\n  const visited = new Set<string>();\n\n  while (stack.length > 0) {\n    const item = stack.pop()!;\n\n    if (item.level >= maxDepth) {\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    const visitKey = `${item.material_id}:${item.path}`;\n    if (visited.has(visitKey)) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    visited.add(visitKey);\n\n    const bomRows: BOMRow[] = await conn.query(\n      `SELECT id, material_id, version, status, is_default\n       FROM prd_bom\n       WHERE material_id = ? const matInfoRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n        `SELECT id, material_code, material_name FROM inv_material WHERE id = ?`,\n        [line.material_id]\n      );\n      const childLeadTime = defaultLeadTime;\n      const childCode = matInfoRows.length > 0 ? matInfoRows[0].material_code || '' : '';\n      const childName = matInfoRows.length > 0 ? matInfoRows[0].material_name || '' : '';\n\n      const childNode: BOMNode = {\n        material_id: line.material_id,\n        material_code: childCode,\n        material_name: childName,\n        quantity: Math.round(grossQty * 10000) / 10000,\n        unit: line.unit || '浠?,\n        level: item.level + 1,\n        path: childPath,\n        is_leaf: true,\n        lead_time_days: childLeadTime,\n        scrap_rate: scrapRate,\n        children: [],\n      };\n\n      if (item.parent_node) {\n        if (!item.parent_node.children) {\n          item.parent_node.children = [];\n        }\n        item.parent_node.children.push(childNode);\n      }\n\n      if (!visited.has(childCircularKey) && item.level + 1 < maxDepth) {\n        stack.push({\n          material_id: line.material_id,\n    parent_node: childNode,\n          parent_qty: grossQty,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return root;\n}\n\n/**\n * 琛ㄧず涓€涓椂闂村垎娈碉紙鏃跺尯锛夊唴鐨?MRP 渚涢渶鏁版嵁\n */\nexport interface TimeBucket {\n  date: string;\n  gross_requirement: number;\n  scheduled_receipt: number;\n  on_hand: number;\n  net_requirement: number;\n  planned_order_release: number;\n  planned_order_receipt:
