鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ュ璞n * @param materialId - 鐗╂枡 ID\n * @param warehouseId - 浠撳簱 ID\n * @param startDate - 璁＄畻璧峰鏃ユ湡锛圷YYY-MM-DD锛塡n * @param endDate - 璁＄畻缁撴潫鏃ユ湡锛圷YYY-MM-DD锛塡n * @param bucketSize - 鏃堕棿鍒嗘绮掑害锛?day' | 'week' | 'month'锛岄粯璁?'week'\n * @returns 鍚勬椂闂村垎娈电殑 MRP 璁＄畻鏄庣粏鏁扮粍\n */\nexport async function calculateTimeBuckets(\n  conn: Loose,\n  materialId: number,\n  warehouseId: number,\n  startDate: string,\n  endDate: string,\n  bucketSize: 'day' | 'week' | 'month' = 'week'\n): Promise<TimeBucket[]> {\n  const buckets = generateBucketDates(startDate, endDate, bucketSize);\n\n  if (buckets.length === 0) {\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  const defaultLeadTime = await CalcParamService.getInt('mrp.default_lead_time_days', 7);\n  const _matInfoRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT id FROM inv_material WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0`,\n    [materialId]\n  );\n  const leadTimeDays = defaultLeadTime;\n\n  const invRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_qty), 0) as total_available\n     FROM inv_inventory\n     WHERE material_id = ? AND warehouse_id = ? AND deleted = 0`,\n    [materialId, warehouseId]\n  );\n  const currentOnHand = Number(invRows.length > 0 ? invRows[0].total_available : 0);\n\n  const requirementRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT\n       DATE(wo.plan_start_date) as req_date,\n       COALESCE(SUM(bd.quantity * wo.plan_qty * (1 + bd.loss_rate / 100)), 0) as total_req\n     FROM prd_work_order wo\n     INNER JOIN prd_bom b ON b.material_id = wo.material_id AND b.status = 1\n     INNER JOIN prd_bom_detail bd ON bd.bom_id = b.id AND bd.material_id = ?\n     WHERE wo.plan_start_date IS NOT NULL\n       AND wo.status IN (1, 2)\n       AND wo.plan_start_date >= ?\n       AND wo.plan_start_date <= ?\n     GROUP BY DATE(wo.plan_start_date)`,\n    [materialId, startDate, endDate]\n  );\n\n  const requirementMap = new Map<string, number>();\n  for (const row of requirementRows) {\n    const dateStr =\n      typeof row.req_date === 'string'\n        ? row.req_date.substring(0, 10)\n        : String(row.req_date).substring(0, 10);\n    requirementMap.set(dateStr, Number(row.total_req));\n  }\n\n  const receiptRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT\n       DATE(po.delivery_date) as receipt_date,\n       COALESCE(SUM(pol.order_qty - pol.received_qty), 0) as total_receipt\n     FROM pur_purchase_order po\n     INNER JOIN pur_purchase_order_line pol ON pol.po_id = po.id\n     WHERE pol.material_id = ?\n       AND po.deleted = 0\n       AND po.status IN (20, 30, 40)\n       AND po.delivery_date IS NOT NULL\n       AND po.delivery_date >= ?\n       AND po.delivery_date <= ?\n       AND pol.order_qty > pol.received_qty\n     GROUP BY DATE(po.delivery_date)`,\n    [materialId, startDate, endDate]\n  );\n\n  const receiptMap = new Map<string, number>();\n  for (const row of receiptRows) {\n    const dateStr =\n      typeof row.receipt_date === 'string'\n        ? row.receipt_date.substring(0, 10)\n        : String(row.receipt_date).substring(0, 10);\n    receiptMap.set(dateStr, Number(row.total_receipt));\n  }\n\n  const result: TimeBucket[] = [];\n  let runningOnHand = currentOnHand;\n\n  for (const bucket of buckets) {\n    let grossReq = 0;\n    let schedReceipt = 0;\n\n    // 姹囨€昏鍒嗘鍐呮墍鏈夋棩鏈熺殑姣涢渶姹傚拰璁″垝鏀惰揣\n    for (const d of bucket.dates) {\n      const dStr = formatDateStr(d);\n      grossReq += requirementMap.get(dStr) || 0;\n      schedReceipt += receiptMap.get(dStr) || 0;\n    }\n\n    // 棰勮鍦ㄦ墜搴撳瓨 = max(0, 婊氬姩鎵嬪湪 + 璁″垝鏀惰揣 - 姣涢渶姹?\n    const onHand = Math.max(0, runningOnHand + schedReceipt - grossReq);\n    // 鍑€闇€姹?= max(0, 姣涢渶姹?- 鍦ㄦ墜搴撳瓨 - 璁″垝鏀惰揣)\n    const netReq = Math.max(0, grossReq - runningOnHand - schedReceipt);\n\n    let plannedRelease = 0;\n    let plannedReceipt = 0;\n\n    if (netReq > 0) {\n      plannedReceipt = netReq;\n      plannedRelease = netReq;\n    }\n\n    result.push({\n      date: bucket.label,\n      gross_requirement: Math.round(grossReq * 10000) / 10000,\n      scheduled_receipt: Math.round(schedReceipt * 10000) / 10000,\n      on_hand: Math.round(onHand * 10000) / 10000,\n      net_requirement: Math.round(netReq * 10000) / 10000,\n      planned_order_release: Math.round(plannedRelease * 10000) / 10000,\n      planned_order_receipt: Math.round(plannedReceipt * 10000) / 10000,\n    });\n\n    runningOnHand = onHand;\n  }\n\n  // 鏍规嵁鎻愬墠鏈熷墠绉昏鍒掕鍗曪細鎺ユ敹鏃ユ湡鐨勬椂闂村垎娈?-> 閲婃斁鏃ユ湡鐨勬椂闂村垎娈礬n  for (let i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {\n    if (result[i].planned_order_receipt > 0) {\n      const releaseBucketIdx = i - Math.ceil(leadTimeDays / getBucketDays(bucketSize));\n      if (releaseBucketIdx >= 0) {\n        result[releaseBucketIdx].planned_order_release = result[i].planned_order_receipt;\n        result[i].planned_order_release = 0;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  return result;\n}\n\nfunction getBucketDays(bucketSize: 'day' | 'week' | 'month'): number {\n  switch (bucketSize) {\n    case 'day':\n      return 1;\n    case 'week':\n      return 7;\n    case 'month':\n      return 30;\n  }\n}\n\ninterface BucketDates {\n  label: string;\n  dates: Date[];\n}\n\nfunction generateBucketDates(\n  startDate: string,\n  endDate: string,\n  bucketSize: 'day' | 'week' | 'month'\n): BucketDates[] {\n  const start = new Date(startDate + 'T00:00:00');\n  const end = new Date(endDate + 'T00:00:00');\n  const buckets: BucketDates[] = [];\n\n  if (start > end) {\n    return buckets;\n  }\n\n  let current = new Date(start);\n\n  while (current <= end) {\n    const bucketStart = new Date(current);\n    let bucketEnd: Date;\n\n    switch (bucketSize) {\n      case 'day':\n        bucketEnd = new Date(current);\n        current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1);\n        break;\n      case 'week': {\n        const dayOfWeek = current.getDay();\n        const daysToSunday = dayOfWeek === 0 ? 0 : 7 - dayOfWeek;\n        bucketEnd = new Date(current);\n        bucketEnd.setDate(bucketEnd.getDate() + daysToSunday);\n        if (bucketEnd > end) bucketEnd = new Date(end);\n        current.setDate(current.getDate() + daysToSunday + 1);\n        break;\n      }\n      case 'month': {\n        bucketEnd = new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth() + 1, 0);\n        if (bucketEnd > end) bucketEnd = new Date(end);\n        current = new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth() + 1, 1);\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const dates: Date[] = [];\n    for (let d = new Date(bucketStart); d <= bucketEnd; d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)) {\n      dates.push(new Date(d));\n    }\n\n    buckets.push({\n      label: formatDateStr(bucketStart),\n      dates,\n    });\n  }\n\n  return buckets;\n}\n\nfunction formatDateStr(date: Date): string {\n  const year = date.getFullYear();\n  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;\n}\n\nfunction addDays(dateStr: string, days: number): string {\n  const d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');\n  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);\n  return formatDateStr(d);\n}\n\n/**\n * 琛ㄧず鍗曚釜鐗╂枡鐨勫噣闇€姹傚垎鏋愮粨鏋淺n */\nexport interface NetRequirement {\n  material_id: number;\n  material_code: string;\n  material_name: string;\n  unit: string;\n  gross_requirement: number;\n  on_hand_qty: number;\n  allocated_qty: number;\n  in_transit_qty: number;\n  safety_stock: number;\n  net_requirement: number;\n  lead_time_days: number;\n  suggested_order_date: string;\n  suggested_delivery_date: string;\n  suggested_order_qty: number;\n  shortage_warning: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * 璁＄畻宸ュ崟鐨勫噣闇€姹俓n *\n * 閽堝鎸囧畾鐨勫伐鍗曞垪琛紝灞曞紑姣忎釜宸ュ崟浜у搧鐨?BOM 鏍戯紝姹囨€绘墍鏈夊彾瀛愮墿鏂欑殑姣涢渶姹傞噺锛孿n * 鍐嶇粨鍚堝簱瀛樸€佸凡鍒嗛厤閲忋€佸湪閫旈噺鍜屽畨鍏ㄥ簱瀛樿绠楁瘡涓墿鏂欑殑鍑€闇€姹傘€俓n *\n * 鍑€闇€姹傚叕寮忥細netReq = max(0, grossRequirement - onHandQty + allocatedQty - inTransitQty + safetyStock)\n *\n * @param conn - 鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ュ璞n * @param workOrderIds - 宸ュ崟 ID 鏁扮粍\n * @param warehouseId - 浠撳簱 ID\n * @returns 鍚勭墿鏂欑殑鍑€闇€姹傚垎鏋愮粨鏋滄暟缁勶紝鎸夌墿鏂欒仛鍚堟眹鎬籠n */\nexport async function calculateNetRequirements(\n  conn: Loose,\n  workOrderIds: number[],\n  warehouseId: number\n): Promise<NetRequirement[]> {\n  if (!workOrderIds || workOrderIds.length === 0) {\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  const placeholders = workOrderIds.map(() => '?').join(',');\n\n  const workOrders: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT wo.id, wo.work_order_no, wo.plan_qty, wo.plan_start_date, wo.material_id\n     FROM prd_work_order wo\n     WHERE wo.id IN (${placeholders})`,\n    workOrderIds\n  );\n\n  if (!workOrders || workOrders.length === 0) {\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  const materialRequirements = new Map<\n    number,\n    {\n      total_qty: number;\n      unit: string;\n      material_code: string;\n      material_name: string;\n      earliest_start_date: string;\n      work_order_ids: number[];\n    }\n  >();\n\n  for (const wo of workOrders) {\n    if (!wo.material_id) continue;\n    const bomTree = await explodeBOM(conn, wo.material_id, Number(wo.plan_qty || 0));\n\n    const leafMaterials = collectLeafMaterials(bomTree);\n\n    for (const leaf of leafMaterials) {\n      const existing = materialRequirements.get(leaf.material_id);\n      if (existing) {\n        existing.total_qty += leaf.quantity;\n        if (wo.plan_start_date) {\n          if (!existing.earliest_start_date || wo.plan_start_date < existing.earliest_start_date) {\n            existing.earliest_start_date = wo.plan_start_date.substring(0, 10);\n          }\n        }\n        if (!existing.work_order_ids.includes(wo.id)) {\n          existing.work_order_ids.push(wo.id);\n        }\n      } else {\n        materialRequirements.set(leaf.material_id, {\n          total_qty: leaf.quantity,\n          unit: leaf.unit,\n          material_code: leaf.material_code,\n          material_name: leaf.material_name,\n          earliest_start_date: wo.plan_start_date\n            ? wo.plan_start_date.substring(0, 10)\n            : formatDateStr(new Date()),\n          work_order_ids: [wo.id],\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const results: NetRequirement[] = [];\n  const materialReqEntries = Array.from(materialRequirements.entries());\n\n  for (const entry of materialReqEntries) {\n    const materialId = entry[0];\n    const req = entry[1];\n    const invRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_qty), 0) as total_available\n       FROM inv_inventory\n       WHERE material_id = ? AND warehouse_id = ? AND deleted = 0`,\n      [materialId, warehouseId]\n    );\n    const onHandQty = Number(invRows.length > 0 ? invRows[0].total_available : 0);\n\n    const allocatedRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mii.issued_qty), 0) as total_allocated\n       FROM prd_material_issue_item mii\n       INNER JOIN prd_material_issue mi ON mi.id = mii.issue_id\n       WHERE mii.material_id = ?\n         AND mi.warehouse_id = ?\n         AND mi.deleted = 0\n         AND mi.status IN (1, 2)`,\n      [materialId, warehouseId]\n    );\n    const allocatedQty = Number(allocatedRows.length > 0 ? allocatedRows[0].total_allocated : 0);\n\n    const inTransitRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n      `SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pol.order_qty - pol.received_qty), 0) as total_in_transit\n       FROM pur_purchase_order_line pol\n       INNER JOIN pur_purchase_order po ON po.id = pol.po_id\n       WHERE pol.material_id = ?\n         AND po.deleted = 0\n         AND po.status IN (30, 40)\n         AND pol.order_qty > pol.received_qty`,\n      [materialId]\n    );\n    const inTransitQty = Number(inTransitRows.length > 0 ? inTransitRows[0].total_in_transit : 0);\n\n    const defaultLeadTime = await CalcParamService.getInt('mrp.default_lead_time_days', 7);\n    const matInfoRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n      `SELECT id, material_code, material_name, unit, safety_stock, purchase_price\n       FROM inv_material WHERE id = ? AND deleted = 0`,\n      [materialId]\n    );\n\n    let safetyStock = 0;\n    let leadTimeDays = defaultLeadTime;\n    let materialCode = req.material_code;\n    let materialName = req.material_name;\n    let unit = req.unit;\n\n    if (matInfoRows && matInfoRows.length > 0) {\n      const matInfo = matInfoRows[0];\n      safetyStock = Number(matInfo.safety_stock || 0);\n      leadTimeDays = defaultLeadTime;\n      materialCode = matInfo.material_code || materialCode;\n      materialName = matInfo.material_name || materialName;\n      unit = matInfo.unit || unit;\n    }\n\n    const netReq = Math.max(\n      0,\n      req.total_qty - onHandQty + allocatedQty - inTransitQty + safetyStock\n    );\n\n    const earliestDate = req.earliest_start_date || formatDateStr(new Date());\n    const suggestedOrderDate = addDays(earliestDate, -leadTimeDays);\n    const suggestedDeliveryDate = earliestDate;\n\n    const shortageWarning = onHandQty < safetyStock;\n\n    results.push({\n      material_id: materialId,\n      material_code: materialCode,\n      material_name: materialName,\n      unit: unit,\n      gross_requirement: Math.round(req.total_qty * 10000) / 10000,\n      on_hand_qty: Math.round(onHandQty * 10000) / 10000,\n      allocated_qty: Math.round(allocatedQty * 10000) / 10000,\n      in_transit_qty: Math.round(inTransitQty * 10000) / 10000,\n      safety_stock: Math.round(safetyStock * 10000) / 10000,\n      net_requirement: Math.round(netReq * 10000) / 10000,\n      lead_time_days: leadTimeDays,\n      suggested_order_date: suggestedOrderDate,\n      suggested_delivery_date: suggestedDeliveryDate,\n      suggested_order_qty: Math.round(netReq * 10000) / 10000,\n      shortage_warning: shortageWarning,\n    });\n  }\n\n  return results;\n}\n\nfunction collectLeafMaterials(node: BOMNode): Array<{\n  material_id: number;\n  material_code: string;\n  material_name: string;\n  quantity: number;\n  unit: string;\n}> {\n  const leaves: Array<{\n    material_id: number;\n    material_code: string;\n    material_name: string;\n    quantity: number;\n    unit: string;\n  }> = [];\n\n  if (node.is_leaf) {\n    leaves.push({\n      material_id: node.material_id,\n      material_code: node.material_code,\n      material_name: node.material_name,\n      quantity: node.quantity,\n      unit: node.unit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {\n    for (const child of node.children) {\n      const childLeaves = collectLeafMaterials(child);\n      leaves.push(...childLeaves);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return leaves;\n}\n\n/**\n * 琛ㄧず MRP 璁＄畻鐢熸垚鐨勮鍒掕鍗昞n */\nexport interface PlannedOrder {\n  material_id: number;\n  material_code: string;\n  material_name: string;\n  unit: string;\n  quantity: number;\n  required_date: string;\n  order_date: string;\n  source_type: 'mrp';\n  source_ids: number[];\n  priority: 'urgent' | 'normal' | 'low';\n}\n\n/**\n * 鏍规嵁鍑€闇€姹傜敓鎴愯鍒掕鍗昞n *\n * 灏嗗噣闇€姹傝绠楃粨鏋滆浆鍖栦负璁″垝璁㈠崟銆傛寜鐗╂枡鑱氬悎鍑€闇€姹傞噺锛屾牴鎹渶姹傛棩鏈熻窛绂讳粖澶╃殑澶╂暟\n * 鑷姩璁剧疆浼樺厛绾э細\n * - 璺濅粖澶?鈮? 澶╋細绱ф€ワ紙urgent锛塡n * - 璺濅粖澶?鈮?4 澶╋細姝ｅ父锛坣ormal锛塡n * - 鍏朵粬锛氫綆锛坙ow锛塡n *\n * @param conn - 鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ュ璞n * @param workOrderIds - 宸ュ崟 ID 鏁扮粍\n * @param warehouseId - 浠撳簱 ID\n * @returns 鎸夌墿鏂欒仛鍚堢殑璁″垝璁㈠崟鏁扮粍\n */\nexport async function generatePlannedOrders(\n  conn: Loose,\n  workOrderIds: number[],\n  warehouseId: number\n): Promise<PlannedOrder[]> {\n  const netRequirements = await calculateNetRequirements(conn, workOrderIds, warehouseId);\n\n  const positiveReqs = netRequirements.filter((r) => r.net_requirement > 0);\n\n  const orderMap = new Map<number, PlannedOrder>();\n\n  for (const req of positiveReqs) {\n    const existing = orderMap.get(req.material_id);\n    if (existing) {\n      existing.quantity += req.suggested_order_qty;\n      existing.source_ids = Array.from(new Set(existing.source_ids.concat(workOrderIds)));\n      if (req.suggested_delivery_date < existing.required_date) {\n        existing.required_date = req.suggested_delivery_date;\n        existing.order_date = req.suggested_order_date;\n      }\n    } else {\n      const now = new Date();\n      const todayStr = formatDateStr(now);\n      const requiredDate = req.suggested_delivery_date || todayStr;\n      const daysUntilRequired = Math.ceil(\n        (new Date(requiredDate + 'T00:00:00').getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)\n      );\n\n      let priority: 'urgent' | 'normal' | 'low';\n      if (daysUntilRequired <= 3) {\n        priority = 'urgent';\n      } else if (daysUntilRequired <= 14) {\n        priority = 'normal';\n      } else {\n        priority = 'low';\n      }\n\n      const woIds = netRequirements\n        .filter((r) => r.material_id === req.material_id)\n        .flatMap((_r) => {\n          return workOrderIds;\n        });\n      const uniqueWoIds = Array.from(new Set(woIds));\n\n      orderMap.set(req.material_id, {\n        material_id: req.material_id,\n        material_code: req.material_code,\n        material_name: req.material_name,\n        unit: req.unit,\n        quantity: req.suggested_order_qty,\n        required_date: requiredDate,\n        order_date: req.suggested_order_date,\n        source_type: 'mrp',\n        source_ids: uniqueWoIds,\n        priority,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  return Array.from(orderMap.values());\n}\n\n/**\n * 鏍规嵁 MRP 璁″垝璁㈠崟鑷姩鐢熸垚閲囪喘鐢宠\n *\n * 灏嗚鍒掕鍗曟寜渚涘簲鍟嗗垎缁勶紝涓烘瘡缁勫垱寤轰竴鏉￠噰璐敵璇凤紙pur_request锛夛紝\n * 骞朵负姣忎釜鐗╂枡鍒涘缓閲囪喘鐢宠鏄庣粏琛岋紙pur_request_item锛夈€俓n * 閲囪喘鐢宠缂栧彿鏍煎紡锛歅R + 鏃ユ湡 + 4浣嶉殢鏈烘暟銆俓n *\n * @param conn - 鏁版嵁搴撹繛鎺ュ璞n * @param plannedOrders - 璁″垝璁㈠崟鏁扮粍\n * @param operatorId - 鎿嶄綔浜?ID\n * @param operatorName - 鎿嶄綔浜哄悕绉癨n * @returns 鐢熸垚鐨勯噰璐敵璇峰垪琛紝姣忛」鍖呭惈鐢宠缂栧彿鍜岀墿鏂欓」鏁癨n */\nexport async function generatePurchaseRequestsFromMRP(\n  conn: Loose,\n  plannedOrders: PlannedOrder[],\n  operatorId: number | null,\n  _operatorName: string\n): Promise<{ request_no: string; item_count: number }[]> {\n  if (!plannedOrders || plannedOrders.length === 0) {\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  const materialIds = plannedOrders.map((o) => o.material_id);\n  const matPlaceholders = materialIds.map(() => '?').join(',');\n\n  const supplierMap = new Map<number | null, PlannedOrder[]>();\n\n  const matSupplierRows: Loose = await conn.query(\n    `SELECT id, material_code, material_name\n     FROM inv_material\n     WHERE id IN (${matPlaceholders})`,\n    materialIds\n  );\n\n  const matSupplierLookup = new Map<number, number | null>();\n  for (const row of matSupplierRows) {\n    matSupplierLookup.set(row.id, null);\n  }\n\n  for (const order of plannedOrders) {\n    const supplierId = matSupplierLookup.get(order.material_id) || null;\n    const group = supplierMap.get(supplierId) || [];\n    group.push(order);\n    supplierMap.set(supplierId, group);\n  }\n\n  const results: { request_no: string; item_count: number }[] = [];\n  const supplierEntries = Array.from(supplierMap.entries());\n\n  for (const entry of supplierEntries) {\n    const supplierId = entry[0];\n    const orders = entry[1];\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dateStr = `${now.getFullYear()}${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n    const randomDigits = String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000)).padStart(4, '0');\n    end_hour: number;\n  }>;\n}\n\n/**\n * 澧炲己鎺掔▼缁撴灉鎺ュ彛\n * @description 琛ㄧず鍗曚釜宸ュ崟鐨勫畬鏁存帓绋嬬粨鏋滐紝鍖呭惈姣忛亾宸ュ簭鐨勬帓绋嬭鎯呫€佹暣浣撴椂闂磋寖鍥村拰鍐茬獊淇℃伅\n */\nexport interface SchedulingResultEnhanced {\n  /** 宸ュ崟 ID */\n end_time: string;\n    /** 鎸佺画鏃堕暱锛堝皬鏃讹級 */\n    duration_hours: number;\n    /** 鎺掔▼鐘舵€?*/\n    status: 'scheduled' | 'conflict' | 'unscheduled';\n  }>;\n  /** 鏁翠綋寮€濮嬫椂闂达紙绗竴閬撳凡鎺掔▼宸ュ簭鐨勫紑濮嬫椂闂达級 */\n  overall_start: string;\n  /** 鏁翠綋缁撴潫鏃堕棿锛堟渶鍚庝竴閬撳凡鎺掔▼宸ュ簭鐨勭粨鏉熸椂闂达級 */\n  overall_end: string;\n  /** 鍐茬獊鍒楄〃 */\n  conflicts: Array<{\n    /** 鍐茬獊宸ュ簭搴忓彿 */\n    seq_no: number;\n    /** 鍐茬獊鍘熷洜 */\n    reason: string;\n  }>;\n}\n\nconst WORKING_HOURS_PER_DAY_DEFAULT = 8;\nconst DAYS_AHEAD_DEFAULT = 30;\n\n/**\n * 鑾峰彇鍙敤璁惧鍒楄〃\n * @description 浠庢暟鎹簱鏌ヨ褰撳墠鐘舵€佷负鍙敤锛坈urrent_status = 1锛夌殑璁惧淇℃伅\n * @param workshop - 鍙€夛紝鎸夎溅闂寸瓫閫夎澶嘰n * @returns 鍙敤璁惧鏁扮粍\n * @throws 鏁版嵁搴撴煡璇㈠紓甯竆n */\nexport async function getAvailableEquipment(workshop?: string): Promise<Equipment[]> {\n  const defaultMaxColors = await CalcParamService.getInt('schedule.default_max_colors', 4);\n  const defaultSetupTime = await CalcParamService.getInt('schedule.default_setup_time_minutes', 30);\n  let sql = `\n    SELECT id, equipment_code, equipment_name, equipment_type, workshop_id as workshop,\n           rated_capacity as capacity_per_hour, current_status as status,\n           ? as max_colors, ? as setup_time_minutes\n    FROM eqp_equipment\n    WHERE current_status = 1 AND deleted = 0\n  `;\n  const params: SqlValue[] = [defaultMaxColors, defaultSetupTime];\n   if (workshop) {\n    sql += ' AND workshop_id = ?';\n    params.push(workshop);\n  }\n  sql += ' ORDER BY workshop_id, equipment_type, equipment_code';\n\n  const rows = await query<DbRow>(sql, params);\n  return rows;\n}\n\n/**\n * 鑾峰彇宸ュ崟鐨勯鑹插伐搴忓垪琛╘n * @description 浠庢暟鎹簱鏌ヨ鎸囧畾宸ュ崟鍏宠仈鐨勯鑹插伐搴忎俊鎭紝鎸夊伐搴忓簭鍙锋帓搴廫n * @param workOrderId - 宸ュ崟 ID\n * @returns 棰滆壊宸ュ簭鏁扮粍锛屾寜 seq_no 鍗囧簭鎺掑垪\n * @throws 鏁版嵁搴撴煡璇㈠紓甯竆n */\nexport async function getWorkOrderColorSequences(workOrderId: number): Promise<ColorSequence[]> {\n  const rows = await query<DbRow>(\n    `SELECT seq_no, color_name, screen_plate_id, ink_formula_id,\n            estimated_duration_hours, equipment_type_required, depends_on_seq\n     FROM prd_work_order_color_seq\n     WHERE work_order_id = ? AND deleted = 0\n     ORDER BY seq_no`,\n    [workOrderId]\n  );\n  return rows;\n}\n\n/**\n * 鎸夐鑹蹭緷璧栧叧绯昏绠楁帓绋媆n * @description 鎺掔▼绠楁硶鏍稿績锛氫负宸ュ崟鐨勬瘡閬撻鑹插伐搴忎緷娆″垎閰嶅悎閫傜殑璁惧銆俓n *   绠楁硶娴佺▼锛歕n *   1. 鎸夐鑹插伐搴忓簭鍙烽亶鍘嗭紱\n *   2. 绛涢€夊尮閰嶅伐搴忔墍闇€璁惧绫诲瀷鐨勫彲鐢ㄨ澶囷紱\n *   3. 鑻ユ棤鍖归厤璁惧锛屾爣璁颁负 conflict锛沑n *   4. 鑻ュ伐搴忔湁渚濊禆鐨勫墠搴忓伐搴忥紝浠庡墠搴忕粨鏉熸椂闂村紑濮嬶紱\n *   5. 璁＄畻瀹為檯宸ユ湡锛堝熀浜庡伐鍗曟暟閲忓拰璁惧浜ц兘锛夛紱\n *   6. 鍦ㄩ€傞厤璁惧涓悳绱㈡渶鏃╁彲鐢ㄦ椂闂存Ы锛沑n *   7. 灏嗘柊鎺掔▼浣嶇疆鍔犲叆宸插瓨鍦ㄦ帓绋嬪垪琛ㄩ伩鍏嶉噸鍙狅紱\n *   8. 璁板綍姣忛亾宸ュ簭鐨勬帓绋嬬粨鏋滃拰鍐茬獊淇℃伅銆俓n *\n * @param workOrder - 寰呮帓绋嬬殑宸ュ崟锛堝寘鍚鑹插伐搴忎俊鎭級\n * @param equipmentList - 鍙敤璁惧鍒楄〃\n * @param existingSchedules - 宸叉湁鎺掔▼璁板綍锛岀敤浜庨伩鍏嶆椂闂村啿绐乗n * @param startDate - 鎺掔▼璧峰鏃ユ湡锛岄粯璁や负褰撳墠鏃ユ湡\n * @returns 鎺掔▼缁撴灉锛屽寘鍚瘡閬撳伐搴忕殑鐘舵€併€佹椂闂村畨鎺掑拰鍐茬獊\n */\nexport function calculateScheduleWithColorDependencies(\n  workOrder: WorkOrderWithColors,\n  equipmentList: Equipment[],\n  existingSchedules: ScheduleSlot[],\n  startDate: Date = new Date()\n): SchedulingResultEnhanced {\n  const result: SchedulingResultEnhanced = {\n    work_order_id: workOrder.id,\n    work_order_no: workOrder.work_order_no,\n    color_sequences: [],\n    overall_start: '',\n    overall_end: '',\n    conflicts: [],\n  };\n\n  let currentTime = new Date(startDate);\n  currentTime.setHours(8, 0, 0, 0);\n\n  for (const colorSeq of workOrder.color_sequences) {\n    const suitableEquipment = equipmentList.filter((eq) => {\n      // 璁惧绫诲瀷鍖归厤锛歝onfigurable mapping (keyed by lowercase string)\n      // 涔熸敮鎸佺洿鎺ユ暟鍊煎尮閰嶏紝鍏煎涓嶅悓鏁版嵁鏉ユ簮\n      const reqType = String(colorSeq.equipment_type_required).toLowerCase().trim();\n      const eqTypeVal = Number(eq.equipment_type);\n      const typeMap: Record<string, number[]> = {\n        printing: [1],\n        die_cutting: [3],\n        inspection: [4],\n        drying: [5],\n        plate_making: [5],\n      };\n      const matchingTypes = typeMap[reqType] ?? [];\n      const typeMatch = matchingTypes.some((t) => Number(t) === eqTypeVal);\n\n      // 鐘舵€佸尮閰嶏細缁熶竴鏁板瓧姣旇緝锛屽吋瀹?tinyint 杩斿洖鏁板瓧鎴栧瓧绗︿覆涓ょ鎯呭喌\n      const statusMatch = Number(eq.status) === 1;\n\n      return typeMatch && statusMatch;\n    });\n\n    if (suitableEquipment.length === 0) {\n      result.conflicts.push({\n        seq_no: colorSeq.seq_no,\n        reason: `鏃犲彲鐢ㄨ澶囩被鍨? ${colorSeq.equipment_type_required}`,\n      });\n      result.color_sequences.push({\n        seq_no: colorSeq.seq_no,\n        color_name: colorSeq.color_name,\n        equipment_id: 0,\n        equipment_name: '鏃犲彲鐢ㄨ澶?,\n        start_time: '',\n        end_time: '',\n        duration_hours: colorSeq.estimated_duration_hours,\n        status: 'conflict',\n      });\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    if (colorSeq.depends_on_seq) {\n      const prevSeq = result.color_sequences.find((s) => s.seq_no === colorSeq.depends_on_seq);\n      if (prevSeq && prevSeq.end_time) {\n        currentTime = new Date(prevSeq.end_time);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 鍏堥€夊畾璁惧锛堝彇浜ц兘鏈€浼橈級锛屽啀鎸変骇鑳借绠楀伐鏈焅n    let bestEquipment = suitableEquipment[0];\n    let earliestStart = new Date(currentTime);\n    let foundSlot = false;\n\n    for (const equipment of suitableEquipment) {\n      const slot = findEarliestSlot(equipment, existingSchedules, currentTime, 1);\n      if (slot && (!foundSlot || slot.start < earliestStart)) {\n        earliestStart = slot.start;\n        bestEquipment = equipment;\n        foundSlot = true;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 鏂规A锛歞urationHours = max(1, ceil(plan_qty / capacity_per_hour))\n    const capacityPerHour = bestEquipment.capacity_per_hour || 100;\n    const durationHours = Math.max(\n      1,\n      Math.ceil(workOrder.plan_qty / capacityPerHour)\n    );\n\n    if (!foundSlot) {\n      result.conflicts.push({\n        seq_no: colorSeq.seq_no,\n        reason: '鏃犳硶鍦ㄨ鍒掓椂闂村唴鎵惧埌鍙敤鏃堕棿妲?,\n      });\n      result.color_sequences.push({\n        seq_no: colorSeq.seq_no,\n        color_name: colorSeq.color_name,\n        equipment_id: bestEquipment.id,\n        equipment_name: bestEquipment.equipment_name,\n        start_time: '',\n        end_time: '',\n        duration_hours: durationHours,\n        status: 'unscheduled',\n      });\n      continue;\n    }\n\n    const endTime = new Date(earliestStart.getTime() + durationHours * 3600000);\n\n    result.color_sequences.push({\n      seq_no: colorSeq.seq_no,\n      color_name: colorSeq.color_name,\n      equipment_id: bestEquipment.id,\n      equipment_name: bestEquipment.equipment_name,\n      start_time: earliestStart.toISOString(),\n      end_time: endTime.toISOString(),\n      duration_hours: durationHours,\n      status: 'scheduled',\n    });\n\n    existingSchedules.push({\n      equipment_id: bestEquipment.id,\n      equipment_name: bestEquipment.equipment_name,\n      date: earliestStart.toISOString().split('T')[0],\n      hour_start: earliestStart.getHours(),\n      hour_end: endTime.getHours(),\n      crosses_day: endTime.getDate() !== earliestStart.getDate(),\n      available_capacity: bestEquipment.capacity_per_hour,\n      scheduled_orders: [\n        {\n          work_order_id: workOrder.id,\n          work_order_no: workOrder.work_order_no,\n          color_seq_no: colorSeq.seq_no,\n          qty: workOrder.plan_qty,\n          start_hour: earliestStart.getHours(),\n          end_hour: endTime.getHours(),\n        },\n      ],\n    });\n\n    currentTime = new Date(endTime);\n  }\n\n  if (result.color_sequences.length > 0) {\n    const scheduledSeqs = result.color_sequences.filter((s) => s.status === 'scheduled');\n    if (scheduledSeqs.length > 0) {\n      result.overall_start = scheduledSeqs[0].start_time;\n      result.overall_end = scheduledSeqs[scheduledSeqs.length - 1].end_time;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return result;\n}\n\n/**\n * 鏌ユ壘璁惧鐨勬渶鏃╁彲鐢ㄦ椂闂存Ы\n * @description 鍦ㄦ寚瀹氭棩鏈熻寖鍥村唴鎼滅储璁惧涓婅繛缁彲鐢ㄤ笖鏃堕暱婊¤冻瑕佹眰鐨勬椂闂存銆俓n *   宸ヤ綔鏃舵鍜屾悳绱㈣寖鍥寸敱 sys_calc_param 閰嶇疆锛堥粯璁?8:00-16:00锛屾悳绱?30 澶╋級銆俓n * @param equipment - 鐩爣璁惧\n * @param existingSchedules - 宸叉湁鎺掔▼璁板綍\n * @param afterTime - 鎼滅储璧峰鏃堕棿\n * @param durationHours - 闇€瑕佺殑杩炵画鏃堕暱锛堝皬鏃讹級\n * @returns 鎵惧埌鐨勬椂闂存Ы璧锋鏃堕棿锛屾湭鎵惧埌杩斿洖 null\n * @private\n */\nfunction findEarliestSlot(\n  equipment: Equipment,\n  existingSchedules: ScheduleSlot[],\n  afterTime: Date,\n  durationHours: number\n): { start: Date; end: Date; crossesDay: boolean } | null {\n  const candidateStart = new Date(afterTime);\n  const maxSearchDays = CalcParamService.getCachedInt(\n    'schedule.search_days_ahead',\n    DAYS_AHEAD_DEFAULT\n  );\n\n  for (let day = 0; day < maxSearchDays; day++) {\n    const dateStr = candidateStart.toISOString().split('T')[0];\n    const daySchedules = existingSchedules.filter(\n      (s) => s.equipment_id === equipment.id && s.date === dateStr\n    );\n\n    const workStart = CalcParamService.getCachedInt('schedule.work_start_hour', 8);\n    const workEnd =\n      workStart +\n      CalcParamService.getCachedInt(\n        'schedule.working_hours_per_day',\n        WORKING_HOURS_PER_DAY_DEFAULT\n      );\n\n    for (\n      let hour = Math.max(workStart, candidateStart.getHours());\n      hour <= workEnd - durationHours;\n      hour++\n    ) {\n      const slotStart = new Date(candidateStart);\n      slotStart.setHours(hour, 0, 0, 0);\n      const slotEnd = new Date(slotStart.getTime() + durationHours * 3600000);\n\n      // 鐢ㄥ畬鏁?Date 姣旇緝妫€娴嬮噸鍙狅細[slotStart, slotEnd) 涓?[sStart, sEnd) 鐩镐氦\n      const hasConflict = daySchedules.some((s) => {\n        const sStart = new Date(slotStart);\n        sStart.setHours(s.hour_start, 0, 0, 0);\n        const sEnd = s.crosses_day\n          ? (() => {\n              const d = new Date(sStart);\n              d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);\n              d.setHours(s.hour_end, 0, 0, 0);\n              return d;\n            })()\n          : (() => {\n              const d = new Date(sStart);\n              d.setHours(s.hour_end, 0, 0, 0);\n              return d;\n            })();\n        // 鍖洪棿閲嶅彔鍒ゆ柇\n        return slotStart < sEnd && slotEnd > sStart;\n      });\n\n      if (!hasConflict) {\n        const crossesDay = slotEnd.getDate() !== slotStart.getDate();\n        return { start: slotStart, end: slotEnd, crossesDay };\n      }\n    }\n\n    candidateStart.setDate(candidateStart.getDate() + 1);\n    candidateStart.setHours(workStart, 0, 0, 0);\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * 鎵归噺鑷姩鎺掔▼宸ュ崟\n * @description 涓哄涓伐鍗曟壒閲忔墽琛屾帓绋嬭绠椼€傚鐞嗘祦绋嬶細\n *   1. 鑾峰彇鎵€鏈夊彲鐢ㄨ澶囷紱\n *   2. 閫愪釜鍔犺浇宸ュ崟淇℃伅鍙婇鑹插伐搴忥紱\n *   3. 鏃犻鑹插伐搴忕殑宸ュ崟鑷姩娣诲姞榛樿宸ュ簭锛沑n *   4. 鎸変紭鍏堢骇锛坲rgent > high > normal > low锛夊拰鎴鏃ユ湡鎺掑簭锛沑n *   5. 渚濇涓烘瘡涓伐鍗曡皟鐢?calculateScheduleWithColorDependencies 杩涜鎺掔▼銆俓n *\n * @param workOrderIds - 寰呮帓绋嬬殑宸ュ崟 ID 鏁扮粍\n * @param options - 鎺掔▼閫夐」\n * @param options.startDate - 鎺掔▼璧峰鏃ユ湡锛圛SO 瀛楃涓诧級锛岄粯璁や负褰撳墠鏃ユ湡\n * @param options.respectDeadline - 鏄惁鎸夋埅姝㈡棩鏈熸帓搴忥紝榛樿涓?true\n * @param options.priorityWeight - 浼樺厛绾ф潈閲嶏紙棰勭暀鍙傛暟锛塡n * @returns 鎵€鏈夊伐鍗曠殑鎺掔▼缁撴灉鏁扮粍\n */\nexport async function autoScheduleWorkOrders(\n  workOrderIds: number[],\n  options?: {\n    startDate?: string;\n    respectDeadline?: boolean;\n    priorityWeight?: number;\n  }\n): Promise<SchedulingResultEnhanced[]> {\n  const startDate = options?.startDate ?
